## Catalog inputs

This step generates catalog summaries, supplementary tables, reference-catalog
comparisons and a release package. FASTA records are selected by exact identifier.
Inputs include the working database, the step 99 release and the source files
referenced in each section.

```{r}
#| label: release-consistency
#| cache: false
fasta_file <- path_source("99-db_publish", "vOTUs.fasta.gz")
stopifnot(file.exists(fasta_file), nzchar(Sys.which("seqkit")))
exit_code <- system2(Sys.which("seqkit"), c("fx2tab", "-n", "-i", "-l", "-j", "2",
  "-o", shQuote(path_target("released-sequence-lengths.tsv")), shQuote(fasta_file)))
stopifnot(exit_code == 0)
seqs <- readr::read_tsv(path_target("released-sequence-lengths.tsv"),
  col_names = c("contig_repid", "fasta_length"), show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(seqs$contig_repid), all(seqs$fasta_length > 0))
release_con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("AvianViromeDB.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
released <- DBI::dbGetQuery(release_con,
  "SELECT contig_repid, vOTU_id, contig_length FROM vOTU_annotation")
DBI::dbDisconnect(release_con)
work_con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
catalog <- DBI::dbGetQuery(work_con,
  "SELECT contig_repid, vOTU_id, contig_length, class, family FROM contig_annotation_filtered_vOTU")
original <- DBI::dbGetQuery(work_con,
  "SELECT contig_id AS contig_repid, contig_length AS original_length FROM contig_annotation")
DBI::dbDisconnect(work_con)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(released$contig_repid), !anyDuplicated(catalog$vOTU_id),
  !anyDuplicated(original$contig_repid))
joined <- released |>
  dplyr::full_join(seqs, by = "contig_repid") |>
  dplyr::left_join(original, by = "contig_repid")
summary_release <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = c("released_annotation_rows", "fasta_records", "annotation_without_fasta",
    "fasta_without_annotation", "fasta_length_differs_from_annotation",
    "fasta_without_original_record", "fasta_length_differs_from_original",
    "release_working_id_pair_differences", "release_working_length_differences"),
  count = c(nrow(released), nrow(seqs),
    sum(is.na(joined$fasta_length) & !is.na(joined$vOTU_id)),
    sum(!is.na(joined$fasta_length) & is.na(joined$vOTU_id)),
    sum(joined$fasta_length != joined$contig_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(!is.na(joined$fasta_length) & is.na(joined$original_length)),
    sum(joined$fasta_length != joined$original_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    nrow(dplyr::anti_join(released, catalog, by = c("contig_repid", "vOTU_id"))) +
      nrow(dplyr::anti_join(catalog, released, by = c("contig_repid", "vOTU_id"))),
    nrow(dplyr::inner_join(released, catalog, by = c("contig_repid", "vOTU_id"),
      suffix = c("_release", "_working")) |>
      dplyr::filter(contig_length_release != contig_length_working))))
readr::write_tsv(summary_release, path_target("release-consistency-summary.tsv"))
jsonlite::write_json(list(
  generated_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC"),
  inputs = c(fasta = fasta_file, released = here::here("AvianViromeDB.sqlite"),
    working = here::here("pc028e3.sqlite")),
  md5 = as.list(tools::md5sum(c(fasta_file, here::here("AvianViromeDB.sqlite")))),
  result = summary_release), path_target("release-consistency.json"),
  pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
knitr::kable(summary_release)
```

## Representative identifier validation

Representative identifiers are matched to Table S2, the clustering map, CheckV
lengths and the sequence release. Joins use complete identifiers and unique keys.

```{r}
#| label: representative-provenance
#| cache: false
con_trace <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
trace_columns <- paste("contig_id, contig_repid, vOTU_id, contig_length,",
  "checkv_completeness, checkv_quality_score, checkv_contamination, lifestyle, class, family,",
  "genomad_virus_score, virsorter2_score, vibrant_quality_score")
df_filtered <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con_trace, paste("SELECT rowid AS input_order,",
  trace_columns, "FROM contig_annotation_filtered ORDER BY rowid"))
df_base <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con_trace, paste("SELECT", trace_columns,
  "FROM contig_annotation"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_trace)
con_archived <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("AvianViromeDB.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_final <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con_archived, paste("SELECT",
  sub("contig_id, ", "", trace_columns, fixed = TRUE),
  "FROM vOTU_annotation"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_archived)
df_selected <- df_filtered |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(checkv_completeness), input_order) |>
  dplyr::distinct(vOTU_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
df_s2 <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "supplementary",
  "Supplementary table S2.xlsx"), skip = 1)
df_cluster_map <- data.table::fread(path_source("00-raw", "d10-import", "map-aniclst.tsv"))
df_checkv_raw <- data.table::fread(path_source("00-raw", "d10-import",
  "checkv-quality_summary.tsv"))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_selected$vOTU_id), !anyDuplicated(df_s2$vOTU_id),
  !anyDuplicated(df_cluster_map$ctgid), !anyDuplicated(df_checkv_raw$contig_id))
df_trace <- df_selected |>
  dplyr::transmute(vOTU_id, selected_contig_id = contig_id,
    selected_old_representative = contig_repid, selected_length = contig_length,
    selected_completeness = checkv_completeness) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_final, by = "vOTU_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::transmute(df_s2, vOTU_id, s2_contig_id = contig_id,
    s2_length = as.numeric(contig_length)), by = "vOTU_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::transmute(df_cluster_map,
    selected_contig_id = ctgid, original_cluster_representative = repid),
    by = "selected_contig_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(seqs, by = "contig_repid") |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::transmute(df_base, contig_repid = contig_id,
    base_representative_length = contig_length,
    base_representative_completeness = checkv_completeness), by = "contig_repid") |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::transmute(df_checkv_raw, contig_repid = contig_id,
    raw_representative_length = contig_length,
    raw_representative_completeness = completeness), by = "contig_repid") |>
  dplyr::mutate(representative_in_filtered = contig_repid %in% df_filtered$contig_id,
    member_switched = selected_contig_id != contig_repid,
    length_mismatch = fasta_length != contig_length,
    selection_reason = dplyr::case_when(
      !member_switched ~ "original representative selected",
      is.na(base_representative_length) ~ "original representative absent at initial import",
      !representative_in_filtered ~ "original representative removed by final filters",
      selected_completeness > base_representative_completeness ~ "another member has higher completeness",
      selected_completeness == base_representative_completeness ~ "completeness tie resolved by input order",
      TRUE ~ "unexplained selection"))
stopifnot(nrow(df_trace) == nrow(df_final),
  all(df_trace$selected_contig_id == df_trace$s2_contig_id),
  all(df_trace$selected_length == df_trace$contig_length),
  all(df_trace$s2_length == df_trace$contig_length),
  all(df_trace$contig_repid == df_trace$selected_old_representative),
  all(df_trace$contig_repid == df_trace$original_cluster_representative),
  all(df_trace$fasta_length == df_trace$raw_representative_length),
  !any(df_trace$selection_reason == "unexplained selection"))

# Compare every retained scalar attribute used here with the selected member.
attribute_fields <- c("contig_length", "checkv_completeness", "checkv_quality_score",
  "checkv_contamination", "lifestyle", "class", "family")
df_attributes <- dplyr::inner_join(df_final, df_selected, by = "vOTU_id",
  suffix = c("_final", "_selected"))
df_attribute_check <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(attribute_fields, function(field) {
  x <- df_attributes[[paste0(field, "_final")]]
  y <- df_attributes[[paste0(field, "_selected")]]
  equal <- (is.na(x) & is.na(y)) | (!is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & x == y)
  tibble::tibble(field = field, mismatches_with_selected_member = sum(!equal))
}))
stopifnot(all(df_attribute_check$mismatches_with_selected_member == 0))
df_reason_summary <- df_trace |>
  dplyr::count(selection_reason, length_mismatch, name = "votus")

# Reproduce the import gates for representatives that lack a base-table row.
df_genomad_raw <- data.table::fread(path_source("00-raw", "d10-import",
  "genomad-summary.tsv"), select = c("seq_name", "virus_score")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(contig_repid = sub("\\|.*", "", seq_name)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(contig_repid) |>
  dplyr::summarise(genomad_present = TRUE,
    genomad_pass = any(virus_score >= 0.8, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
df_vs_score <- data.table::fread(path_source("00-raw", "d10-import",
  "virsorter2-score.tsv"), select = c("seqname", "max_score"))
df_vs_category <- data.table::fread(path_source("00-raw", "d10-import",
  "virsorter2-category.csv"), select = "Contig")
df_import_trace <- df_trace |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(base_representative_length)) |>
  dplyr::select(vOTU_id, contig_repid) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_genomad_raw, by = "contig_repid") |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::transmute(df_vs_score,
    contig_repid = seqname, virsorter2_score = max_score), by = "contig_repid") |>
  dplyr::mutate(vs_category_present = contig_repid %in% df_vs_category$Contig,
    exclusion_reason = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(genomad_present) ~ "geNomad join missing",
      !genomad_pass ~ "geNomad below initial threshold",
      is.na(virsorter2_score) ~ "VirSorter2 score join missing",
      !vs_category_present ~ "VirSorter2 category join missing",
      virsorter2_score < 0.9 ~ "VirSorter2 below initial threshold",
      TRUE ~ "unexplained initial exclusion"))
stopifnot(!any(df_import_trace$exclusion_reason == "unexplained initial exclusion"))
df_final_exclusions <- df_trace |>
  dplyr::filter(selection_reason == "original representative removed by final filters") |>
  dplyr::select(vOTU_id, contig_repid) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_base |>
    dplyr::select(contig_id, genomad_virus_score, virsorter2_score,
      checkv_completeness, checkv_contamination, vibrant_quality_score),
    by = c("contig_repid" = "contig_id")) |>
  dplyr::transmute(vOTU_id, contig_repid,
    genomad_filter = is.na(genomad_virus_score) | genomad_virus_score < 0.9,
    virsorter2_filter = is.na(virsorter2_score) | virsorter2_score < 0.9,
    contamination_filter = is.na(checkv_contamination) | checkv_contamination > 5,
    completeness_filter = is.na(checkv_completeness) | checkv_completeness < 20,
    vibrant_filter = !vibrant_quality_score %in% 1:4)
stopifnot(all(rowSums(df_final_exclusions[, 3:7]) > 0))
df_final_exclusion_counts <- df_final_exclusions |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::ends_with("_filter"), names_to = "criterion", values_to = "failed") |>
  dplyr::group_by(criterion) |>
  dplyr::summarise(votus = sum(failed), .groups = "drop")
df_trace <- df_trace |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_import_trace |>
    dplyr::select(vOTU_id, exclusion_reason), by = "vOTU_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_final_exclusions |>
    dplyr::select(-contig_repid), by = "vOTU_id")
readr::write_tsv(df_trace |> dplyr::filter(member_switched),
  path_target("representative-provenance.tsv"))
jsonlite::write_json(list(
  selection_and_length = df_reason_summary,
  attribute_match_to_selected = df_attribute_check,
  original_representative_initial_exclusion = df_import_trace |>
    dplyr::count(exclusion_reason, name = "votus"),
  original_representative_final_exclusion_overlapping = df_final_exclusion_counts,
  length_direction = df_trace |>
    dplyr::filter(member_switched) |>
    dplyr::count(direction = sign(fasta_length - contig_length), name = "votus"),
  all_released_lengths_match_source_checkv = TRUE,
  s2_selected_members_reproduced = nrow(df_trace)),
  path_target("representative-provenance-summary.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
knitr::kable(df_reason_summary)
knitr::kable(df_attribute_check)
knitr::kable(df_import_trace |> dplyr::count(exclusion_reason, name = "votus"))
knitr::kable(df_final_exclusion_counts)

df_plot_reasons <- df_reason_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(length_mismatch) |>
  dplyr::mutate(reason = dplyr::recode(selection_reason,
    "another member has higher completeness" = "Selected member has higher completeness",
    "completeness tie resolved by input order" = "Equal completeness; earlier member selected",
    "original representative absent at initial import" = "Old representative excluded at initial import",
    "original representative removed by final filters" = "Old representative excluded by final filters"))
p_reasons <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_plot_reasons,
  ggplot2::aes(x = votus, y = reorder(reason, votus))) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#D55E00", width = 0.65) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = scales::comma(votus)), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.13))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "vOTUs with unequal released and annotated lengths", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank())
ggplot2::ggsave(path_target("fig100a-representative-disagreement.png"), p_reasons,
  width = 240, height = 90, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Release package and supplementary identifiers

The publisher validates identifiers, sequence lengths, annotation records and
checksums before exporting the package. Network identifiers are retained alongside
the sequence representative identifiers.

```{r}
#| label: corrected-release
#| cache: false
path_release <- path_target("release")
path_manifest <- file.path(path_release, "manifest.json")
if (!file.exists(path_manifest)) {
  stopifnot(nzchar(Sys.which("uv")))
  release_status <- system2(Sys.which("uv"), c("run", "--locked", "--script",
    shQuote(here::here("publish.py")), "--output-dir", shQuote(path_release)))
  stopifnot(release_status == 0)
}
release_manifest <- jsonlite::read_json(path_manifest, simplifyVector = TRUE)
sha256_file <- function(path) digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
stopifnot(sha256_file(here::here("publish.py")) == release_manifest$publisher_sha256,
  sha256_file(here::here("publish.py.lock")) == release_manifest$dependency_lock_sha256)
for (input in release_manifest$inputs) {
  stopifnot(sha256_file(input$path) == input$sha256)
}
for (filename in names(release_manifest$files)) {
  stopifnot(sha256_file(file.path(path_release, filename)) ==
    release_manifest$files[[filename]]$sha256)
}
con_corrected <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), file.path(path_release, "AvianViromeDB.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_corrected <- DBI::dbReadTable(con_corrected, "vOTU_annotation")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_corrected)
df_s2_map <- df_s2 |>
  dplyr::select(vOTU_id, contig_id) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_corrected |>
    dplyr::select(vOTU_id, contig_repid, original_representative_id), by = "vOTU_id")
stopifnot(nrow(df_s2_map) == nrow(df_s2),
  all(df_s2_map$contig_id == df_s2_map$contig_repid))
df_repair_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = c("vOTUs", "representative_ids_updated", "length_mismatches",
    "identifier_mismatches", "s2_member_matches", "unchanged_annotation_rows"),
  count = c(nrow(df_corrected), release_manifest$representatives_changed,
    release_manifest$length_mismatches, release_manifest$identifier_mismatches,
    sum(df_s2_map$contig_id == df_s2_map$contig_repid),
    release_manifest$counts$virus_prokyriotic_hosts + release_manifest$counts$amg_dramv +
      release_manifest$counts$amg_vibrant + release_manifest$counts$arg))
readr::write_tsv(df_repair_summary, path_target("representative-repair-summary.tsv"))
knitr::kable(df_repair_summary)
```

The [release package](data/100-reviewer-revision/release/) includes a
[manifest](data/100-reviewer-revision/release/manifest.json) with validation results
and checksums.

```{r}
#| label: unchanged-sequence-validation
#| cache: false
unchanged_ids <- df_corrected$contig_repid[
  df_corrected$contig_repid == df_corrected$original_representative_id]
path_hashes <- path_target("scratch", "release-hashes")
dir.create(path_hashes, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
df_hash_checks <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c("vOTUs.fasta.gz", "vOTU_proteins.faa.gz"), function(filename) {
  hashes <- lapply(c(archived = path_source("99-db_publish", filename),
    corrected = file.path(path_release, filename)), function(fasta) {
      path_hash <- tempfile(tmpdir = path_hashes, fileext = ".tsv")
      on.exit(unlink(path_hash), add = TRUE)
      status <- system2(Sys.which("seqkit"), c("fx2tab", "-j", "2", "-n", "-i", "-s", "-I",
        shQuote(fasta)), stdout = path_hash)
      stopifnot(status == 0)
      df <- data.table::fread(path_hash, header = FALSE, col.names = c("id", "sequence_md5"))
      stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df$id))
      if (filename == "vOTUs.fasta.gz") stopifnot(nrow(df) == nrow(df_corrected))
      parent <- if (filename == "vOTUs.fasta.gz") df$id else sub("_[0-9]+$", "", df$id)
      df[parent %in% unchanged_ids, ]
    })
  stopifnot(setequal(hashes$archived$id, hashes$corrected$id))
  matched <- merge(hashes$archived, hashes$corrected, by = "id")
  stopifnot(all(matched$sequence_md5.x == matched$sequence_md5.y))
  if (filename == "vOTUs.fasta.gz") stopifnot(nrow(matched) == length(unchanged_ids))
  tibble::tibble(file = filename, unchanged_records_checked = nrow(matched), differences = 0L)
}))
readr::write_tsv(df_hash_checks, path_target("unchanged-sequence-checks.tsv"))
knitr::kable(df_hash_checks)
```

## Figure 4: all entries and the named-family subset

Missing and placeholder names are displayed as unassigned; raw annotations are
unchanged. Panel B includes every named family. Both panels show absolute counts;
the family-assigned denominator and full-catalog unresolved count are explicit.

```{r}
#| label: taxonomy-summary
#| cache: false
display_rank <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "" | grepl("^\\[", x), "Unassigned", x)
}
class_counts <- catalog |>
  dplyr::mutate(taxon = display_rank(class)) |> dplyr::count(taxon, name = "n")
family_counts <- catalog |>
  dplyr::mutate(taxon = display_rank(family)) |> dplyr::count(taxon, name = "n")
named_family <- family_counts |> dplyr::filter(taxon != "Unassigned")
unassigned_n <- sum(family_counts$n[family_counts$taxon == "Unassigned"])
stopifnot(sum(class_counts$n) == nrow(catalog),
  sum(named_family$n) + unassigned_n == nrow(catalog))
readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(class = class_counts, family = family_counts,
  .id = "rank"), path_target("figure4-counts.tsv"))
base_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 8, base_family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5, 14, 5, 5))
p_class <- ggplot2::ggplot(class_counts,
  ggplot2::aes(x = n, y = reorder(taxon, n))) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.2, color = "#0072B2") +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = n * 1.3, label = scales::comma(n)), hjust = 0, size = 2.6) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000),
    labels = scales::comma, expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "A  Class assignments", subtitle = paste0("All ",
    scales::comma(nrow(catalog)), " catalog entries"),
    x = "Number of vOTUs (log10 scale)", y = NULL) + base_theme
p_family <- ggplot2::ggplot(named_family,
  ggplot2::aes(x = n, y = reorder(taxon, n))) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#009E73", width = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 2.6) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.16))) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "B  Named family assignments", subtitle = paste0(
    scales::comma(sum(named_family$n)), " assigned\n", scales::comma(unassigned_n),
    " unassigned (", round(100 * unassigned_n / nrow(catalog), 2), "% of all entries)"),
    x = "Number of vOTUs", y = NULL) + base_theme
figure4 <- cowplot::plot_grid(p_class, p_family, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 1.1))

# Submission exports use physical dimensions; PNG provides a raster preview.
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 183, height_mm = 205, dpi = 600) {
  width_in <- width_mm / 25.4
  height_in <- height_mm / 25.4
  svglite::svglite(paste0(filename, ".svg"), width = width_in, height = height_in,
    system_fonts = list(sans = "Arial"))
  print(plot); grDevices::dev.off()
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = width_in,
    height = height_in, family = "Arial")
  print(plot); grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(filename, ".tiff"), width = width_in, height = height_in,
    units = "in", res = dpi, compression = "lzw")
  print(plot); grDevices::dev.off()
}
save_pub_r(figure4, path_target("figure4-taxonomy"))
ggplot2::ggsave(path_target("figure4-taxonomy-preview.png"), figure4,
  width = 183, height = 205, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

![Named-family counts remain readable while the unassigned fraction stays explicit.](data/100-reviewer-revision/figure4-taxonomy-preview.png)

## Figure 5: predicted microbial hosts

Host predictions and GC measurements are summarized for the selected
representatives. Each scatter point represents one vOTU; multiple predicted phyla
receive their own label. Host-category counts can overlap across vOTUs. Genus
multiplicity describes the number of genera assigned by the prediction output.

```{r}
#| label: figure5-data
#| cache: false
con_fig <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_hosts_raw <- DBI::dbReadTable(con_fig, "host_filtered")
df_hosts <- df_hosts_raw |>
  tidyr::separate(Host.taxonomy, into = c("Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order",
    "Family", "Genus", "Species"), sep = ";", fill = "right") |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(Domain:Species,
    ~ dplyr::na_if(stringr::str_remove(.x, "^[a-z]__"), "")))
df_dramv <- DBI::dbReadTable(con_fig, "amg_dramv_filtered")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_fig)
df_fig5 <- df_corrected |>
  dplyr::filter(checkv_completeness > 90) |>
  dplyr::rename(contig_id = contig_repid)
df_gc <- readr::read_tsv(here::here(path_raw, "d55-fig5", "gc.tsv"),
  col_names = c("contig_id", "gc_percent"), show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_gc$contig_id),
  all(df_fig5$checkv_contamination <= 5),
  all(df_fig5$checkv_quality_score %in% c(1, 2)),
  all(df_hosts$Confidence.score >= 90))
df_fig5 <- df_fig5 |> dplyr::left_join(df_gc, by = "contig_id")
stopifnot(!anyNA(df_fig5$gc_percent))
gc_status <- system2(Sys.which("seqkit"), c("fx2tab", "-n", "-i", "-g", "-j", "2",
  "-o", shQuote(path_target("representative-gc.tsv")),
  shQuote(file.path(path_release, "vOTUs.fasta.gz"))))
stopifnot(gc_status == 0)
df_gc_sequence <- readr::read_tsv(path_target("representative-gc.tsv"),
  col_names = c("contig_id", "sequence_gc_percent"), show_col_types = FALSE)
df_gc_check <- df_fig5 |> dplyr::left_join(df_gc_sequence, by = "contig_id")
stopifnot(nrow(df_gc_check) == nrow(df_fig5), !anyNA(df_gc_check$sequence_gc_percent),
  all(abs(df_gc_check$gc_percent - df_gc_check$sequence_gc_percent) <= 0.011))
df_s4 <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "supplementary",
  "Supplementary table S4.xlsx"), skip = 1)
host_fields <- names(df_hosts_raw)
normalize_host <- function(df) {
  df |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(host_fields)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.character), ~ dplyr::coalesce(.x, ""))) |>
    dplyr::distinct()
}
df_s4_fig5 <- df_s4 |> dplyr::filter(contig_id %in% df_fig5$contig_id) |> normalize_host()
df_hosts_fig5 <- df_hosts_raw |> dplyr::filter(contig_id %in% df_fig5$contig_id) |> normalize_host()
s4_only_rows <- nrow(dplyr::anti_join(df_s4_fig5, df_hosts_fig5, by = host_fields))
figure_only_host_rows <- nrow(dplyr::anti_join(df_hosts_fig5, df_s4_fig5, by = host_fields))
stopifnot(s4_only_rows == 0, figure_only_host_rows == 0)
df_host_pairs <- df_fig5 |>
  dplyr::select(contig_id, vOTU_id, contig_length, lifestyle, class) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(df_hosts |> dplyr::distinct(contig_id, Phylum, Genus),
    by = "contig_id", relationship = "one-to-many") |>
  dplyr::distinct()
df_phylum_pairs <- df_host_pairs |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(Phylum)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(vOTU_id, Phylum)
df_phylum_counts <- df_phylum_pairs |> dplyr::count(Phylum, name = "votus")
df_genus_pairs <- df_host_pairs |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genus)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(vOTU_id, Genus)
df_genus_n <- df_genus_pairs |> dplyr::count(vOTU_id, name = "predicted_genera")
df_genus_hist <- df_genus_n |> dplyr::count(predicted_genera, name = "votus")
df_fig5_scatter <- df_fig5 |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_phylum_pairs |> dplyr::group_by(vOTU_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(phylum_label = if (dplyr::n() == 1) Phylum[[1]] else
      "Multiple predicted phyla", .groups = "drop"), by = "vOTU_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(phylum_label = dplyr::coalesce(phylum_label, "Phylum unassigned"))
top_phyla <- df_phylum_counts |> dplyr::slice_max(votus, n = 6, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::pull(Phylum)
df_fig5_scatter <- df_fig5_scatter |>
  dplyr::mutate(phylum_label = ifelse(phylum_label %in% c(top_phyla,
    "Multiple predicted phyla", "Phylum unassigned"), phylum_label, "Other phyla"))
df_fig5_genera <- df_genus_pairs |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_fig5 |> dplyr::select(vOTU_id, contig_length, lifestyle, checkv_completeness),
    by = "vOTU_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_genus_n, by = "vOTU_id") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Genus) |>
  dplyr::summarise(votus = dplyr::n(), median_length = median(contig_length),
    q25_length = quantile(contig_length, 0.25), q75_length = quantile(contig_length, 0.75),
    min_completeness = min(checkv_completeness), median_completeness = median(checkv_completeness),
    max_completeness = max(checkv_completeness),
    temperate_percent = 100 * mean(lifestyle == "temperate"),
    multiple_genera_percent = 100 * mean(predicted_genera > 1), .groups = "drop")
df_fig5_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = c("near_complete_votus", "complete", "high_quality", "host_prediction_votus",
    "without_host_prediction", "phylum_assigned_votus", "predicted_phyla",
    "votu_phylum_pairs", "genus_assigned_votus", "one_predicted_genus",
    "multiple_predicted_genera", "displayed_genera_min_60_votus", "gc_missing",
    "displayed_genera_unique_votus", "s4_only_prediction_rows", "figure_only_prediction_rows"),
  count = c(nrow(df_fig5), sum(df_fig5$checkv_quality_score == 1),
    sum(df_fig5$checkv_quality_score == 2),
    dplyr::n_distinct(df_host_pairs$vOTU_id),
    sum(!df_fig5$contig_id %in% df_hosts$contig_id),
    dplyr::n_distinct(df_phylum_pairs$vOTU_id), nrow(df_phylum_counts),
    nrow(df_phylum_pairs), nrow(df_genus_n), sum(df_genus_n$predicted_genera == 1),
    sum(df_genus_n$predicted_genera > 1), sum(df_fig5_genera$votus >= 60),
    sum(is.na(df_fig5$gc_percent)),
    dplyr::n_distinct(df_genus_pairs$vOTU_id[df_genus_pairs$Genus %in%
      df_fig5_genera$Genus[df_fig5_genera$votus >= 60]]), s4_only_rows, figure_only_host_rows))
stopifnot(nrow(df_fig5_scatter) == nrow(df_fig5),
  sum(df_genus_hist$votus) == nrow(df_genus_n))
readr::write_tsv(df_fig5_summary, path_target("figure5-summary.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_phylum_counts, path_target("figure5-phylum-counts.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_fig5_genera, path_target("figure5-genus-summary.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_genus_hist, path_target("figure5-genus-multiplicity.tsv"))
knitr::kable(df_fig5_summary)
```

## Figure 7: functional annotations

DRAM-v annotations are joined to representative sequences and checked against
Table S9. Each protein is counted once within a displayed category; categories
can overlap. Capitalization is normalized for broad categories, and aerobic and
anaerobic annotations retain their separate labels.

```{r}
#| label: figure7-data
#| cache: false
fig7_fields <- c("contig_id", "protein_id", "dbid", "module", "sheet", "header")
df_fig7_raw <- df_dramv |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(fig7_fields)) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::inner_join(df_corrected |> dplyr::select(contig_repid, vOTU_id),
    by = c("contig_id" = "contig_repid"))
df_s9 <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "supplementary",
  "Supplementary table S9.xlsx"), skip = 1)
normalize_blank <- function(df) {
  df |> dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.character),
    ~ dplyr::coalesce(dplyr::na_if(trimws(.x), ""), "")))
}
df_s9_projection <- df_s9 |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(fig7_fields, "vOTU_id"))) |> normalize_blank()
df_fig7_raw <- normalize_blank(df_fig7_raw)
stopifnot(setequal(df_s9$protein_id, df_fig7_raw$protein_id),
  setequal(df_s9$vOTU_id, df_fig7_raw$vOTU_id),
  nrow(dplyr::anti_join(df_s9_projection, df_fig7_raw, by = names(df_s9_projection))) == 0,
  nrow(dplyr::anti_join(df_fig7_raw, df_s9_projection, by = names(df_s9_projection))) == 0)
df_fig7 <- df_fig7_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(sheet = dplyr::case_when(
    sheet %in% c("carbon utilization", "carbon utilization (Woodcroft)") ~ "Carbon utilization",
    sheet == "" ~ "Unclassified", TRUE ~ sheet),
    header = ifelse(header == "", "Unclassified", header),
    module = ifelse(module == "", "Unclassified", module))
fig7_counts <- function(column, level) {
  df_fig7 |> dplyr::group_by(item = .data[[column]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(proteins = dplyr::n_distinct(protein_id),
      votus = dplyr::n_distinct(vOTU_id),
      category = paste(sort(unique(sheet)), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(level = level)
}
df_fig7_a <- fig7_counts("sheet", "broad_category") |>
  dplyr::mutate(assignment_percent = 100 * proteins / sum(proteins))
df_fig7_b <- fig7_counts("header", "subcategory")
df_fig7_c <- fig7_counts("module", "module")
df_fig7_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = c("s9_rows", "s9_proteins", "s9_votus", "figure_annotation_combinations",
    "figure_proteins", "figure_votus", "s9_duplicate_projected_rows",
    "broad_category_assignments", "s9_only_proteins", "figure_only_proteins",
    "module_unassigned_proteins", "named_module_categories", "named_module_categories_displayed"),
  count = c(nrow(df_s9), dplyr::n_distinct(df_s9$protein_id),
    dplyr::n_distinct(df_s9$vOTU_id), nrow(df_fig7_raw),
    dplyr::n_distinct(df_fig7$protein_id), dplyr::n_distinct(df_fig7$vOTU_id),
    nrow(df_s9_projection) - nrow(dplyr::distinct(df_s9_projection)),
    sum(df_fig7_a$proteins), length(setdiff(df_s9$protein_id, df_fig7$protein_id)),
    length(setdiff(df_fig7$protein_id, df_s9$protein_id)),
    df_fig7_c$proteins[df_fig7_c$item == "Unclassified"],
    sum(df_fig7_c$item != "Unclassified"), min(25, sum(df_fig7_c$item != "Unclassified"))))
stopifnot(nrow(df_s9) - nrow(df_fig7_raw) ==
  sum(duplicated(df_s9_projection)))
readr::write_tsv(df_fig7_summary, path_target("figure7-summary.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(df_fig7_a, df_fig7_b, df_fig7_c),
  path_target("figure7-counts.tsv"))
knitr::kable(df_fig7_summary)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure7-plot
#| cache: false
fig7_palette <- c("MISC" = "#CC79A7", "Organic Nitrogen" = "#E69F00",
  "Carbon utilization" = "#56B4E9", "Transporters" = "#009E73",
  "Unclassified" = "#999999", "Energy" = "#0072B2")
p7a <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_fig7_a,
  ggplot2::aes(proteins, reorder(item, proteins), fill = item)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)",
    scales::comma(proteins), assignment_percent)), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.1) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = fig7_palette) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.58))) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "A  Broad annotation categories", x = "Protein-category assignments", y = NULL) +
  theme_fig + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
fig7_count_plot <- function(df, title, wrap_width) {
  df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(display_category = ifelse(grepl(";", category),
    "Multiple categories", category))
  stopifnot(all(df$display_category %in% c(names(fig7_palette), "Multiple categories")))
  ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(proteins, reorder(item, proteins), color = display_category)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = proteins * 1.15, label = scales::comma(proteins)),
      hjust = 0, size = 2.1, color = "black") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(fig7_palette, "Multiple categories" = "#666666")) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_log10(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.24)),
      labels = scales::comma) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = wrap_width)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, x = "Distinct proteins per category (log10 scale)", y = NULL) +
    theme_fig + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6))
}
p7b <- fig7_count_plot(df_fig7_b, "B  Annotation subcategories", 31)
df_fig7_c_display <- df_fig7_c |> dplyr::filter(item != "Unclassified") |>

jsonlite::write_json(list(

  s4_sha256 = sha256_file(here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "supplementary",

  s9_sha256 = sha256_file(here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "supplementary",

  figure5 = df_fig5_summary, figure7 = df_fig7_summary),
```

## Table 1: counts of existing catalog-linked screening records

This table summarizes existing records and their identifiers. It provides no
additional biological validation. Database-specific counts remain separate;
the four resistance-reference outputs are also deduplicated by identifier for
their combined summary. PlasmidFinder records remain in the downloadable table
and are outside this resistance/virulence screening summary.

```{r}
#| label: screening-record-counts
#| cache: false
con_screen <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), file.path(path_release, "AvianViromeDB.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_screen <- DBI::dbReadTable(con_screen, "arg")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_screen)
resistance_databases <- c("argannot", "card", "ncbi", "resfinder")
df_screen_summary <- df_screen |>
  dplyr::filter(DATABASE %in% c(resistance_databases, "vfdb")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(database = DATABASE) |>
  dplyr::summarise(catalog_linked_records = dplyr::n(),
    sequence_identifiers = dplyr::n_distinct(protein_id),
    source_contig_identifiers = dplyr::n_distinct(source_contig_id),
    votu_identifiers = dplyr::n_distinct(vOTU_id), .groups = "drop")
df_full_screen <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(resistance_databases), function(i) {
  submitted <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "supplementary",
    paste0("Supplementary table S", i + 4, ".xlsx")), skip = 1)
  published_ids <- df_screen$protein_id[df_screen$DATABASE == resistance_databases[[i]]]
  stopifnot(all(published_ids %in% submitted$SEQUENCE), !anyDuplicated(submitted$SEQUENCE))
  tibble::tibble(database = resistance_databases[[i]],
    supplementary_screening_records = nrow(submitted))
}))
df_screen_summary <- df_screen_summary |> dplyr::left_join(df_full_screen, by = "database")
df_resistance_union <- df_screen |> dplyr::filter(DATABASE %in% resistance_databases)
df_screen_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_screen_summary, tibble::tibble(
  database = "resistance_reference_union", catalog_linked_records = NA_integer_,
  sequence_identifiers = dplyr::n_distinct(df_resistance_union$protein_id),
  source_contig_identifiers = dplyr::n_distinct(df_resistance_union$source_contig_id),
  votu_identifiers = dplyr::n_distinct(df_resistance_union$vOTU_id),
  supplementary_screening_records = NA_integer_))
stopifnot(all(df_screen_summary$catalog_linked_records[1:5] ==
  df_screen_summary$sequence_identifiers[1:5]))
# Aggregate output ranges document reported fields, without inferring run settings.
df_screen_raw <- data.table::fread(path_source("00-raw", "d10-import", "anno_abricate.tsv.gz"))
df_screen_ranges <- df_screen_raw |>
  dplyr::group_by(database = DATABASE) |>
  dplyr::summarise(records = dplyr::n(),
    identity_min = min(`%IDENTITY`), identity_max = max(`%IDENTITY`),
    reference_coverage_min = min(`%COVERAGE`),
    reference_coverage_max = max(`%COVERAGE`), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_tsv(df_screen_ranges, path_target("screening-output-ranges.tsv"))
knitr::kable(df_screen_summary)
```

## Table 1 criteria and genomic context of screening records

Table 1 counts catalog-linked records with ≥95% nucleotide identity and ≥75%
coverage of the reference gene, applied to the archived outputs; Table S14 lists
every catalog-linked record with these values. Each record is placed on its source
contig with the DRAM-v coordinates of the annotated gene. A record lies in a CheckV
host region when that gene overlaps a host segment delimited by CheckV; otherwise
a first or last predicted gene is terminal. Exact joins on contig and gene keys
scale linearly with records and genes. The expected number of terminal genes
assumes a uniform gene position within each contig.

```{r}
#| label: screening-context
#| cache: false
screen_databases <- c(resistance_databases, "vfdb")
df_screen_records <- df_screen |>
  dplyr::filter(DATABASE %in% screen_databases) |>
  dplyr::transmute(database = DATABASE, gene = GENE, product = PRODUCT,
    resistance = RESISTANCE, accession = ACCESSION,
    identity = as.numeric(X.IDENTITY), reference_coverage = as.numeric(X.COVERAGE),
    meets_table1_criteria = identity >= 95 & reference_coverage >= 75,
    vOTU_id, exported_representative_id = contig_repid, source_contig_id,
    annotation_sequence_id = protein_id, strand = STRAND, hit_end = as.integer(END),
    gene_ordinal = as.integer(sub("^.*_([0-9]+)$", "\\1", protein_id)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(df_screen_records$identity), !anyNA(df_screen_records$reference_coverage),
  !anyNA(df_screen_records$gene_ordinal))
screen_contigs <- unique(df_screen_records$source_contig_id)
con_screen_work <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
screen_contig_sql <- paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con_screen_work, screen_contigs), collapse = ",")
df_screen_genes <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con_screen_work, paste0(
  "SELECT DISTINCT contig_id AS source_contig_id, CAST(gene_position AS INTEGER) AS gene_ordinal, ",
  "CAST(start_position AS INTEGER) AS gene_start, CAST(end_position AS INTEGER) AS gene_end ",
  "FROM anno_prot_dramv WHERE contig_id IN (", screen_contig_sql, ")"))
retained_screen_members <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con_screen_work, paste0(
  "SELECT contig_id FROM contig_annotation_filtered WHERE contig_id IN (",
  screen_contig_sql, ")"))$contig_id
df_screen_lengths <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con_screen_work, paste0(
  "SELECT contig_id AS source_contig_id, contig_length FROM contig_annotation ",
  "WHERE contig_id IN (", screen_contig_sql, ")"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_screen_work)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_screen_genes[, c("source_contig_id", "gene_ordinal")]),
  !anyDuplicated(df_screen_lengths$source_contig_id))
df_screen_gene_counts <- df_screen_genes |>
  dplyr::group_by(source_contig_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(genes_on_contig = max(gene_ordinal), genes_listed = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop")
stopifnot(all(df_screen_gene_counts$genes_on_contig == df_screen_gene_counts$genes_listed))
df_checkv_regions <- data.table::fread(path_source("00-raw", "hpc", "checkv", "contamination.tsv"),
  select = c("contig_id", "provirus", "region_types", "region_coords_bp"),
  colClasses = "character")
df_checkv_regions <- df_checkv_regions[contig_id %in% screen_contigs]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_checkv_regions$contig_id),
  setequal(df_checkv_regions$contig_id, screen_contigs))
host_region_overlap <- function(types, coords, start, end) {
  if (is.na(types) || types == "NA") return(FALSE)
  type_parts <- strsplit(types, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  bounds <- do.call(rbind, lapply(strsplit(strsplit(coords, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]], "-",
    fixed = TRUE), as.integer))
  stopifnot(length(type_parts) == nrow(bounds))
  any(type_parts == "host" & bounds[, 1] <= end & bounds[, 2] >= start)
}
df_screen_context <- df_screen_records |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_screen_genes, by = c("source_contig_id", "gene_ordinal"),
    relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_screen_gene_counts |> dplyr::select(source_contig_id, genes_on_contig),
    by = "source_contig_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_screen_lengths, by = "source_contig_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_checkv_regions, by = c(source_contig_id = "contig_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    member_status = dplyr::case_when(
      source_contig_id == exported_representative_id ~ "exported representative",
      source_contig_id %in% retained_screen_members ~ "other retained member",
      TRUE ~ "member outside the retained set"),
    in_checkv_host_region = purrr::pmap_lgl(list(region_types, region_coords_bp, gene_start,
      gene_end), host_region_overlap),
    position_class = dplyr::case_when(
      in_checkv_host_region ~ "CheckV host region",
      gene_ordinal == 1L | gene_ordinal == genes_on_contig ~ "first or last gene",
      TRUE ~ "internal gene"),
    distance_to_contig_end = pmin(gene_start - 1L, contig_length - gene_end))
stopifnot(nrow(df_screen_context) == nrow(df_screen_records),
  !anyNA(df_screen_context$gene_start), !anyNA(df_screen_context$contig_length),
  all(df_screen_context$hit_end <= df_screen_context$gene_end - df_screen_context$gene_start + 1L))
summarise_screen_scope <- function(df) {
  sequences <- df |> dplyr::distinct(annotation_sequence_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  tibble::tibble(records = nrow(df),
    annotation_sequences = nrow(sequences),
    source_contigs = dplyr::n_distinct(df$source_contig_id),
    vOTUs = dplyr::n_distinct(df$vOTU_id),
    in_checkv_host_region = sum(sequences$position_class == "CheckV host region"),
    first_or_last_gene = sum(sequences$position_class == "first or last gene"),
    internal_gene = sum(sequences$position_class == "internal gene"),
    expected_first_or_last_gene = round(sum(pmin(1, 2 / sequences$genes_on_contig)), 1),
    exported_representative = sum(sequences$member_status == "exported representative"),
    other_retained_member = sum(sequences$member_status == "other retained member"),
    member_outside_retained_set = sum(sequences$member_status == "member outside the retained set"),
    vOTUs_with_internal_gene_on_retained_member = dplyr::n_distinct(sequences$vOTU_id[
      sequences$position_class == "internal gene" &
        sequences$member_status != "member outside the retained set"]))
}
df_screen_scopes <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c("resistance", "vfdb"), function(scope) {
  df_scope <- df_screen_context |> dplyr::filter(
    if (scope == "resistance") database %in% resistance_databases else database == "vfdb")
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    summarise_screen_scope(df_scope) |> dplyr::mutate(records_included = "all catalog-linked"),
    summarise_screen_scope(df_scope |> dplyr::filter(meets_table1_criteria)) |>
      dplyr::mutate(records_included = "identity >=95% and coverage >=75%")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(scope = scope, .before = 1)
}))
readr::write_tsv(df_screen_scopes, path_target("screening-context-summary.tsv"))
df_table1_criteria <- df_screen_context |>
  dplyr::filter(meets_table1_criteria) |>
  dplyr::group_by(database) |>
  dplyr::summarise(records_meeting_criteria = dplyr::n(),
    source_contigs_meeting_criteria = dplyr::n_distinct(source_contig_id),
    votus_meeting_criteria = dplyr::n_distinct(vOTU_id), .groups = "drop")
df_resistance_criteria <- df_screen_context |>
  dplyr::filter(meets_table1_criteria, database %in% resistance_databases)
df_table1 <- df_screen_summary |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_table1_criteria, by = "database") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    records_meeting_criteria = dplyr::if_else(database == "resistance_reference_union",
      nrow(df_resistance_criteria), records_meeting_criteria),
    sequence_identifiers_meeting_criteria = dplyr::if_else(
      database == "resistance_reference_union",
      dplyr::n_distinct(df_resistance_criteria$annotation_sequence_id), NA_integer_),
    source_contigs_meeting_criteria = dplyr::if_else(database == "resistance_reference_union",
      dplyr::n_distinct(df_resistance_criteria$source_contig_id), source_contigs_meeting_criteria),
    votus_meeting_criteria = dplyr::if_else(database == "resistance_reference_union",
      dplyr::n_distinct(df_resistance_criteria$vOTU_id), votus_meeting_criteria),
    supplementary_screening_records = dplyr::if_else(database == "vfdb",
      sum(df_screen_raw$DATABASE == "vfdb"), supplementary_screening_records))
readr::write_tsv(df_table1, path_target("table1-screening-records.tsv"))
# erm(X) cases: compare annotated members with the exported representative of each vOTU.
df_ermx <- df_screen_context |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("^erm\\(X\\)|^ErmX$", gene)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(annotation_sequence_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
df_ermx_cases <- df_ermx |>
  dplyr::group_by(vOTU_id, exported_representative_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(annotated_members = dplyr::n(),
    members_outside_retained_set = sum(member_status == "member outside the retained set"),
    in_checkv_host_region = sum(position_class == "CheckV host region"),
    first_or_last_gene = sum(position_class == "first or last gene"),
    internal_gene = sum(position_class == "internal gene"),
    gene_ordinal_from_nearest_end_max = max(pmin(gene_ordinal, genes_on_contig - gene_ordinal + 1L)),
    distance_to_contig_end_min = min(distance_to_contig_end),
    distance_to_contig_end_max = max(distance_to_contig_end),
    representative_annotated = any(source_contig_id == exported_representative_id),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_corrected |> dplyr::select(vOTU_id, representative_length = contig_length,
    representative_completeness = checkv_completeness,
    representative_contamination = checkv_contamination,
    representative_provirus = checkv_provirus), by = "vOTU_id", relationship = "one-to-one")
readr::write_tsv(df_ermx_cases, path_target("screening-ermx-cases.tsv"))
s14_columns <- c("database", "gene", "product", "resistance", "accession", "identity",
  "reference_coverage", "meets_table1_criteria", "vOTU_id", "exported_representative_id",
  "source_contig_id", "member_status", "annotation_sequence_id", "gene_ordinal",
  "genes_on_contig", "gene_start", "gene_end", "strand", "contig_length",
  "distance_to_contig_end", "provirus", "region_types", "region_coords_bp",
  "in_checkv_host_region", "position_class")
df_s14_notes <- tibble::tribble(~field, ~meaning,
  "Scope", "Every catalog-linked record from the four resistance-reference databases and VFDB. Tables S5–S8 contain the complete resistance-reference outputs; vfdb_full_output contains the complete VFDB output.",
  "identity / reference_coverage", "Nucleotide identity and coverage of the reference gene reported in the archived screening output.",
  "meets_table1_criteria", "TRUE when identity is at least 95% and reference-gene coverage is at least 75%; Table 1 counts these records.",
  "member_status", "Exported representative, other retained member of the vOTU, or cluster member outside the retained set that links the record to its vOTU.",
  "gene_ordinal / genes_on_contig / gene_start / gene_end", "Position of the annotated gene among the DRAM-v gene predictions of its source contig.",
  "provirus / region_types / region_coords_bp", "CheckV contamination output for the source contig; host regions are segments CheckV classified as host.",
  "position_class", "CheckV host region when the annotated gene overlaps a host region; otherwise first or last gene of the contig, or internal gene.",
  "Interpretation", "Records describe computational annotations and their genomic context. They do not establish resistance or virulence function, or viral carriage.")
writexl::write_xlsx(list(catalog_linked_records = df_screen_context |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(s14_columns)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(database, vOTU_id, source_contig_id, gene_ordinal),
  vfdb_full_output = df_screen_raw |> dplyr::filter(DATABASE == "vfdb"),
  field_notes = df_s14_notes), path_target("table-s14-screening-records.xlsx"))
knitr::kable(df_screen_scopes)
knitr::kable(df_table1)
knitr::kable(df_ermx_cases)
```

## Lifestyle labels across quality tiers and lifestyle tools

Temperate fractions are summarized for each CheckV quality tier and for the
near-complete subset used in the length panels. Agreement between BACPHLIP and
VIBRANT uses representatives with an output from both tools.

```{r}
#| label: lifestyle-quality-agreement
#| cache: false
quality_tiers <- c("1" = "Complete", "2" = "High", "3" = "Medium", "4" = "Low")
df_lifestyle_base <- df_corrected |>
  dplyr::transmute(vOTU_id, quality = unname(quality_tiers[as.character(checkv_quality_score)]),
    near_complete = checkv_completeness > 90 & checkv_contamination <= 5,
    lifestyle, bacphlip_lifestyle, vibrant_type)
stopifnot(nrow(df_lifestyle_base) == 61608, !anyNA(df_lifestyle_base$quality),
  sum(df_lifestyle_base$near_complete) == 12939,
  all(df_lifestyle_base$lifestyle %in% c("temperate", "virulent")))
summarise_lifestyle <- function(df, subset) {
  paired <- df |> dplyr::filter(bacphlip_lifestyle %in% c("lytic", "temperate"),
    vibrant_type %in% c("lytic", "lysogenic"))
  tibble::tibble(subset = subset, vOTUs = nrow(df),
    temperate = sum(df$lifestyle == "temperate"),
    temperate_percent = round(100 * mean(df$lifestyle == "temperate"), 1),
    paired_tool_outputs = nrow(paired),
    bacphlip_vibrant_agreement = sum(
      (paired$bacphlip_lifestyle == "lytic" & paired$vibrant_type == "lytic") |
        (paired$bacphlip_lifestyle == "temperate" & paired$vibrant_type == "lysogenic")),
    agreement_percent = round(100 * bacphlip_vibrant_agreement / paired_tool_outputs, 1))
}
df_lifestyle_quality <- dplyr::bind_rows(c(list(
  summarise_lifestyle(df_lifestyle_base, "All representatives"),
  summarise_lifestyle(df_lifestyle_base |> dplyr::filter(near_complete),
    "Completeness >90% and contamination <=5%")),
  unname(lapply(quality_tiers, function(tier) summarise_lifestyle(
    df_lifestyle_base |> dplyr::filter(quality == tier), tier)))))
readr::write_tsv(df_lifestyle_quality, path_target("lifestyle-quality-agreement.tsv"))
knitr::kable(df_lifestyle_quality)
```

## Table S1: source accessions and metadata

The source table links 2,658 records to registry accessions, source metadata and
project publications. Sample-linked identities and project-level collection
context occupy separate fields. Exact-key joins preserve row multiplicity and
require unique run accessions.

```{r}
#| label: s1-identifiers
#| cache: false
s1 <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "supplementary",
  "Supplementary table S1.xlsx"), skip = 1)
project_ids <- sort(unique(s1$project_id))
registry_file <- path_target("s1-project-registry.tsv")
if (file.exists(registry_file)) {
  registry <- readr::read_tsv(registry_file, col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"))
  stopifnot(setequal(registry$project_id, project_ids))
} else {
  registry <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(project_ids, function(id) {
    url <- paste0("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/xml/", id)
    tryCatch({
      response <- curl::curl_fetch_memory(url,
        handle = curl::new_handle(timeout = 30, connecttimeout = 10))
      stopifnot(response$status_code == 200)
      doc <- xml2::read_xml(response$content)
      project <- xml2::xml_find_first(doc, ".//PROJECT")
      stopifnot(xml2::xml_attr(project, "accession") == id)
      pmids <- xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_all(project,
        ".//XREF_LINK[DB='PUBMED' or DB='PubMed']/ID"))
      tibble::tibble(project_id = id, registry_title = xml2::xml_text(
        xml2::xml_find_first(project, "TITLE")),
        registry_linked_pmids = paste(pmids, collapse = ";"),
        registry_status = ifelse(length(pmids), "linked PMID returned",
          "no PMID link returned; publication status unknown"),
        evidence_url = url, retrieved_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC"))
    }, error = function(e) tibble::tibble(project_id = id, registry_title = NA_character_,
      registry_linked_pmids = NA_character_, registry_status = "registry lookup failed",
      evidence_url = url, retrieved_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC")))
  }))
  readr::write_tsv(registry, registry_file)
}
# Project-publication associations were checked on 2026-10-09 against article

# a preparation protocol to individual runs. All 28 source projects are retained.
```
