```{r}
stopifnot(setequal(publications$project_id, project_ids), !anyDuplicated(publications$project_id))
df_project_notes <- readxl::read_excel(here::here(path_raw, "pc028e3-metadata.xlsx"),
  sheet = "project_id") |>
  dplyr::select(project_id = Accession, source_workbook_finished = finished,
    source_workbook_download_reads = download_reads, source_workbook_comment = comment)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_project_notes$project_id))
df_metadata_raw <- readxl::read_excel(here::here(path_raw, "pc028e3-metadata.xlsx"),
  sheet = "metadata", col_types = c(rep("text", 4), rep("numeric", 2), rep("text", 8)))
metadata_fields <- names(df_metadata_raw)
df_metadata_duplicates <- df_metadata_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(workbook_row = dplyr::row_number() + 1L) |>
  dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(metadata_fields))) |>
  dplyr::summarise(copies = dplyr::n(), workbook_rows = paste(workbook_row, collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(copies > 1)
df_metadata_unique <- dplyr::distinct(df_metadata_raw)
con_metadata <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_metadata_db <- DBI::dbReadTable(con_metadata, "sample_metadata")
df_source_counts <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con_metadata,
  "SELECT study_id, COUNT(*) AS initial_contigs FROM contig_annotation GROUP BY study_id")
df_retained_counts <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con_metadata,
  "SELECT study_id, COUNT(*) AS retained_contigs FROM contig_annotation_filtered GROUP BY study_id")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_metadata)
stopifnot(dplyr::setequal(df_metadata_unique, tibble::as_tibble(df_metadata_db)))
df_metadata_s1 <- df_metadata_unique |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_host != "Grus") |>
  dplyr::mutate(sample_host = dplyr::recode(sample_host, Bird = "Migratory birds"))
s1_fields <- names(s1)
df_s1_counts <- s1 |> dplyr::count(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(s1_fields)))
df_projection_counts <- df_metadata_s1 |>
  dplyr::count(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(s1_fields)))
stopifnot(dplyr::setequal(df_s1_counts, df_projection_counts),
  !anyDuplicated(df_metadata_s1[, s1_fields]))
df_runinfo <- readr::read_tsv(here::here(path_resource, "pc028e3-runinfo.tsv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_runinfo$run_accession))
run_fields <- c("run_accession", "experiment_accession", "sample_accession",
  "library_strategy", "library_source", "library_selection", "library_layout",
  "instrument_platform", "instrument_model", "study_accession", "secondary_study_accession")
df_metadata_provenance <- df_metadata_unique |>
  dplyr::mutate(run_accession = ifelse(grepl("^[SED]RR[0-9]+$", study_id),
    study_id, ifelse(grepl("^[SED]RR[0-9]+$", sample_id), sample_id, NA_character_)),
    run_accession_source = ifelse(grepl("^[SED]RR[0-9]+$", study_id),
      "submitted study_id", "source workbook sample_id; matched through all five S1 fields"),
    input_record_type = ifelse(study_id == "ma2024imeta",
      "reused assembly recorded in source workbook", "sequencing-run record")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_runinfo |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(run_fields)),
    by = "run_accession", relationship = "many-to-one", na_matches = "never") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_project_notes, by = "project_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_source_counts, by = "study_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_retained_counts, by = "study_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(initial_contigs, retained_contigs), ~ dplyr::coalesce(.x, 0L)),
    run_metadata_status = dplyr::case_when(
      study_id == "ma2024imeta" ~ "source run recovered from local metadata; actual assembly input not verified",
      !is.na(library_strategy) ~ "matched to local runinfo by exact run accession",
      TRUE ~ "run metadata not matched"),
    s1_presence = ifelse(sample_host == "Grus", "absent from submitted S1", "present in submitted S1"),
    eligibility_review = dplyr::case_when(
      study_id == "ma2024imeta" & library_strategy == "AMPLICON" ~ "Reused assembly: AMPLICON source-run label conflicts with the metagenomic resource description; verify actual assembly inputs",
      study_id == "ma2024imeta" ~ "Reused assembly: OTHER source-run label does not specify the assay; verify actual assembly inputs",
      library_strategy == "AMPLICON" ~ "Registry labels this run AMPLICON; source processing and eligibility unresolved",
      project_id == "PRJNA1034280" ~ "Confirmed retail chicken meat; retained in the source inventory and source summaries; historical processing contribution unresolved",
      sample_host == "Grus" ~ "Present in metadata; absent from submitted S1; historical inclusion rule unavailable",
      TRUE ~ ""))
stopifnot(!anyNA(df_metadata_provenance$library_strategy),
  all(df_metadata_provenance$project_id == df_metadata_provenance$study_accession |
    df_metadata_provenance$project_id == df_metadata_provenance$secondary_study_accession,
    na.rm = FALSE))
df_s1_provenance <- df_metadata_provenance |>
  dplyr::filter(sample_host != "Grus") |>
  dplyr::mutate(sample_host = dplyr::recode(sample_host, Bird = "Migratory birds")) |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(s1_fields), source_sample_identifier = sample_id,
    input_record_type, run_accession_source, run_metadata_status, dplyr::all_of(run_fields), eligibility_review)
s1_revision <- s1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(submitted_row = dplyr::row_number(),
    source_study_identifier = ifelse(grepl("^[SED]RR[0-9]+$", study_id), NA_character_, study_id),
    bioproject_accession = ifelse(grepl("^PRJ[EDN][AB][0-9]+$", project_id),
      project_id, NA_character_),
    species_source_reported = NA_character_,
    collection_origin_source_reported = NA_character_) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_s1_provenance, by = s1_fields, relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(registry, by = "project_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(publications |> dplyr::select(project_id, publication_doi, publication_pmid,
    publication_linkage, publication_link_scope), by = "project_id", relationship = "many-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(s1_revision) == nrow(s1),
  identical(as.data.frame(s1_revision[, names(s1)]), as.data.frame(s1)))
df_metadata_flow <- tibble::tibble(
  record_set = c("raw_metadata_rows", "duplicate_surplus", "unique_metadata_rows",
    "raw_rows_excluding_grus", "unique_grus_records", "submitted_s1_rows",
    "s1_records_with_source_run_metadata", "s1_run_input_records", "s1_reused_assembly_records",
    "run_input_wgs_labels", "run_input_amplicon_labels", "run_input_other_labels",
    "assembly_source_amplicon_labels", "assembly_source_other_labels",
    "all_s1_wgs_labels", "all_s1_amplicon_labels", "all_s1_other_labels"),
  rows = c(nrow(df_metadata_raw), sum(df_metadata_duplicates$copies - 1L),
    nrow(df_metadata_unique), sum(df_metadata_raw$sample_host != "Grus"),
    sum(df_metadata_unique$sample_host == "Grus"), nrow(s1),
    sum(!is.na(s1_revision$library_strategy)),
    sum(s1_revision$input_record_type == "sequencing-run record"),
    sum(s1_revision$input_record_type == "reused assembly recorded in source workbook"),
    sum(s1_revision$input_record_type == "sequencing-run record" & s1_revision$library_strategy == "WGS"),
    sum(s1_revision$input_record_type == "sequencing-run record" & s1_revision$library_strategy == "AMPLICON"),
    sum(s1_revision$input_record_type == "sequencing-run record" & s1_revision$library_strategy == "OTHER"),
    sum(s1_revision$input_record_type != "sequencing-run record" & s1_revision$library_strategy == "AMPLICON"),
    sum(s1_revision$input_record_type != "sequencing-run record" & s1_revision$library_strategy == "OTHER"),
    sum(s1_revision$library_strategy == "WGS"), sum(s1_revision$library_strategy == "AMPLICON"),
    sum(s1_revision$library_strategy == "OTHER")))
df_eligibility_projects <- df_metadata_provenance |>
  dplyr::filter(eligibility_review != "") |>
  dplyr::group_by(project_id, eligibility_review) |>
  dplyr::summarise(metadata_records = dplyr::n(),
    initial_contigs = if (all(input_record_type == "sequencing-run record")) sum(initial_contigs) else NA_integer_,
    retained_contigs = if (all(input_record_type == "sequencing-run record")) sum(retained_contigs) else NA_integer_,
    .groups = "drop")
sha256_metadata <- function(path) digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
jsonlite::write_json(list(
  source_workbook_sha256 = sha256_metadata(here::here(path_raw, "pc028e3-metadata.xlsx")),
  runinfo_sha256 = sha256_metadata(here::here(path_resource, "pc028e3-runinfo.tsv")),
  submitted_s1_sha256 = sha256_metadata(here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "supplementary",
    "Supplementary table S1.xlsx")),
  raw_distinct_equals_database = TRUE, s1_projection_multiset_matches = TRUE,
  source_host_label_mapping = list(Bird = "Migratory birds"),
  source_run_project_ids_match = TRUE,
  assembly_provenance_status = "Source run IDs are recovered from local metadata; actual assembly input provenance remains unverified.",
  record_counts = df_metadata_flow,
  duplicate_projects = df_metadata_duplicates |>
    dplyr::group_by(project_id, sample_host) |>
    dplyr::summarise(duplicate_surplus = sum(copies - 1L), .groups = "drop"),
  eligibility_review = df_eligibility_projects,
  project_publications_identified = sum(!is.na(publications$publication_doi)),
  project_publications_not_identified = publications$project_id[is.na(publications$publication_doi)]),
  path_target("sample-metadata-audit.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
# Reconstruct identifiers only: exact joins are O(n), with unique contig keys.
# Alias joins retain ambiguity; one sample may have multiple stored aliases.
# No adjacent-row source filling is used. Outputs stay in step 100; no cache.
df_asb_ids <- readr::read_tsv(path_source("00-raw", "d10-import", "map-contig2asb.tsv"),
  col_names = c("contig_id", "recorded_assembly_id"), col_types = "cc") |>
  dplyr::mutate(input_branch = ifelse(grepl("^ma2024imeta__", recorded_assembly_id),
    "reused assembly", "run record"),
    source_label = ifelse(input_branch == "reused assembly",
      sub("^ma2024imeta__(.*?)__.*$", "\\1", recorded_assembly_id),
      sub("_clean$", "", sub("__.*$", "", recorded_assembly_id))))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_asb_ids$contig_id), !anyNA(df_asb_ids$source_label))
# An alternative archived map uses incompatible assignments for the same IDs.
# Record the conflict; do not use its additional IDs to fill the import map.
df_alt_asb_ids <- readr::read_tsv(path_source("00-raw", "hpc", "map_contig2asb.tsv"),
  col_names = c("contig_id", "alternative_assembly_id"), col_types = "cc")
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_alt_asb_ids$contig_id))
df_map_comparison <- df_asb_ids |>
  dplyr::inner_join(df_alt_asb_ids, by = "contig_id", relationship = "one-to-one")
alternative_map_review <- list(
  hpc_map_sha256 = sha256_metadata(path_source("00-raw", "hpc", "map_contig2asb.tsv")),
  wrong_copy_sha256 = sha256_metadata(path_source("00-raw", "d10-import", "map-contig2asb.tsv_wrong")),
  alternative_records = nrow(df_alt_asb_ids), shared_contig_ids = nrow(df_map_comparison),
  equal_assembly_identifiers = sum(df_map_comparison$recorded_assembly_id == df_map_comparison$alternative_assembly_id),
  conflicting_assembly_identifiers = sum(df_map_comparison$recorded_assembly_id != df_map_comparison$alternative_assembly_id),
  used_for_source_filling = FALSE)
df_source_aliases <- df_metadata_unique |>
  dplyr::filter(study_id == "ma2024imeta") |>
  dplyr::select(metadata_sample_id = sample_id, sample_name, sample_name_new_for_ma2024imeta) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-metadata_sample_id, names_to = "alias_field", values_to = "source_label") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(source_label), nzchar(source_label)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(source_label, metadata_sample_id) |>
  dplyr::add_count(source_label, name = "matching_metadata_records")
df_unique_aliases <- df_source_aliases |>
  dplyr::filter(matching_metadata_records == 1) |>
  dplyr::select(source_label, metadata_sample_id) |>
  dplyr::mutate(input_branch = "reused assembly")
df_run_labels <- df_metadata_unique |>
  dplyr::filter(study_id != "ma2024imeta") |>
  dplyr::transmute(source_label = study_id, metadata_sample_id = sample_id,
    input_branch = "run record")
df_label_keys <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_unique_aliases, df_run_labels)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_label_keys[, c("input_branch", "source_label")]))
con_source <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_source_members <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  initial = DBI::dbGetQuery(con_source, "SELECT contig_id, vOTU_id FROM contig_annotation"),
  retained = DBI::dbGetQuery(con_source, "SELECT contig_id, vOTU_id FROM contig_annotation_filtered"),
  .id = "record_set") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_asb_ids, by = "contig_id", relationship = "many-to-one")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_source)
df_source_coverage <- df_source_members |>
  dplyr::group_by(record_set) |>
  dplyr::summarise(contig_records = dplyr::n(),
    with_original_mapping = sum(!is.na(recorded_assembly_id)),
    without_original_mapping = sum(is.na(recorded_assembly_id)), .groups = "drop")
df_votu_source_coverage <- df_source_members |>
  dplyr::group_by(record_set, vOTU_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mapped_members = sum(!is.na(recorded_assembly_id)),
    unmapped_members = sum(is.na(recorded_assembly_id)), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(mapping_status = dplyr::case_when(mapped_members == 0 ~ "all members lack mapping",
    unmapped_members == 0 ~ "all members mapped", TRUE ~ "mixed mapped and unmapped members")) |>
  dplyr::count(record_set, mapping_status, name = "vOTUs")
df_observed_labels <- df_asb_ids |>
  dplyr::count(input_branch, source_label, name = "mapping_file_contigs") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_label_keys, by = c("input_branch", "source_label"), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_source_members |> dplyr::filter(record_set == "retained") |>
    dplyr::count(input_branch, source_label, name = "retained_contig_records"),
    by = c("input_branch", "source_label"), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(retained_contig_records = dplyr::coalesce(retained_contig_records, 0L),
    metadata_match = ifelse(is.na(metadata_sample_id), "no unique exact metadata match",
      "exact stored run identifier or sample-name alias"))
df_record_support <- df_observed_labels |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(metadata_sample_id)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(metadata_sample_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(observed_source_labels = paste(sort(source_label), collapse = ";"),
    matched_assembly_label_count = dplyr::n(),
    retained_contigs_with_exact_label_match = sum(retained_contig_records), .groups = "drop")
s1_revision <- s1_revision |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_record_support, by = c("source_sample_identifier" = "metadata_sample_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(assembly_label_evidence = ifelse(is.na(matched_assembly_label_count),
    "no exact mapping-label match; processing or exclusion status not inferred",
    "exact archival label match; metadata-to-read provenance is not independently established"))
stopifnot(nrow(s1_revision) == nrow(s1),
  identical(as.data.frame(s1_revision[, names(s1)]), as.data.frame(s1)))
readr::write_tsv(df_observed_labels, path_target("source-assembly-labels.tsv"))
jsonlite::write_json(list(
  mapping_file_sha256 = sha256_metadata(path_source("00-raw", "d10-import", "map-contig2asb.tsv")),
  alternative_map_review = alternative_map_review,
  mapping_records = nrow(df_asb_ids), source_label_counts = df_observed_labels |>
    dplyr::count(input_branch, metadata_match, name = "assembly_source_labels"),
  uniquely_matched_reused_metadata_records = dplyr::n_distinct(
    df_observed_labels$metadata_sample_id[df_observed_labels$input_branch == "reused assembly"], na.rm = TRUE),
  contig_mapping_coverage = df_source_coverage, votu_mapping_coverage = df_votu_source_coverage,
  flagged_run_retained_records = df_source_members |>
    dplyr::filter(record_set == "retained", source_label == "SRR22969615") |>
    dplyr::select(contig_id, vOTU_id, source_label) |>
    dplyr::left_join(df_source_members |> dplyr::filter(record_set == "retained") |>
      dplyr::count(vOTU_id, name = "total_retained_members"), by = "vOTU_id", relationship = "many-to-one"),
  interpretation = "Counts describe retained identifier evidence. Missing labels do not prove sample exclusion; multiple aliases do not establish distinct biological samples. No sequence or annotation was changed."),
  path_target("source-record-reconstruction.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
knitr::kable(df_source_coverage)
knitr::kable(df_votu_source_coverage)

# Host curation joins are O(n + m), with exact composite keys and no chunk cache.
# The source snapshot retains accession-specific evidence and retrieval dates.
identity_file <- path_target("source-identity-evidence.json")
identity_source <- jsonlite::read_json(identity_file, simplifyVector = TRUE)
identity_records <- tibble::as_tibble(identity_source$sample_identity_curation)
identity_context <- tibble::as_tibble(identity_source$project_context_curation)
identity_keys <- c("project_id", "run_accession", "sample_accession", "sample_name")
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(identity_records[, identity_keys]),
  !anyNA(identity_records[, identity_keys]),
  !anyDuplicated(identity_context$project_id),
  all(identity_context$project_id %in% publications$project_id),
  nrow(dplyr::anti_join(identity_records, s1_revision, by = identity_keys,
    na_matches = "never")) == 0)
s1_revision <- s1_revision |>
  dplyr::left_join(identity_records |>
    dplyr::rename(species_reviewed = species_source_reported,
      husbandry_reviewed = collection_origin_source_reported),
    by = identity_keys, relationship = "one-to-one", na_matches = "never") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    species_source_reported = dplyr::coalesce(species_reviewed, species_source_reported),
    collection_origin_source_reported = dplyr::coalesce(husbandry_reviewed, collection_origin_source_reported),
    identity_review_status = dplyr::coalesce(identity_review_status, "not yet individually curated")) |>
  dplyr::select(-species_reviewed, -husbandry_reviewed)
publications <- publications |>
  dplyr::left_join(identity_context, by = "project_id", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(s1_revision) == nrow(s1),
  identical(as.data.frame(s1_revision[, names(s1)]), as.data.frame(s1)),
  nrow(dplyr::anti_join(identity_records, s1_revision,
    by = names(identity_records), na_matches = "na")) == 0)
# These crosswalks identify publication sample aliases; registry runs retain
# their own sequencing-unit meaning.
matched_publication_projects <- c("PRJEB22062", "PRJNA861719")
publications <- publications |>
  dplyr::mutate(publication_link_scope = ifelse(
    project_id %in% matched_publication_projects,
    "sample aliases matched to publication supplement; run links from registry",
    publication_link_scope),
    publication_note = ifelse(project_id %in% matched_publication_projects,
      host_context_scope, publication_note))
s1_revision <- s1_revision |>
  dplyr::mutate(publication_link_scope = ifelse(
    project_id %in% matched_publication_projects,
    "sample aliases matched to publication supplement; run links from registry",
    publication_link_scope))
readr::write_tsv(publications, path_target("source-project-publications.tsv"))

# Preserve the submitted fields and expose one reviewed category for all users.
# Unknown identity contributes no known category; Pigeon and Quail remain broad
# source labels with unresolved species. Categories use English common names, so
# the submitted genus label Coturnix becomes Quail; sample_host keeps the
# submitted label. This does not classify domestic/wild birds.
species_categories <- c("Anser indicus" = "Goose", "Anser cygnoides" = "Goose",
  "Cygnus cygnus" = "Swan", "Grus grus" = "Crane", "Tadorna tadorna" = "Duck",
  "Ardea alba" = "Egret", "Tringa nebularia" = "Greenshank", "Gallus gallus" = "Chicken")
stopifnot(all(stats::na.omit(s1_revision$species_source_reported) %in% names(species_categories)))
s1_revision <- s1_revision |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_summary_included = TRUE,
    source_scope_status = ifelse(project_id == "PRJNA1034280",
      "retained poultry-associated source: retail chicken meat",
      "retained source inventory; assay and historical input review remain open"),
    source_scope_evidence_url = ifelse(project_id == "PRJNA1034280",
      "https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11893277/; https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/view/SAMN38056455",
      NA_character_),
    bird_category = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(species_source_reported) ~ unname(species_categories[species_source_reported]),
      identity_review_status %in% c("BioSample matched; publication alias conflicts with registry",
        "publication sample alias matched; species unresolved") ~ NA_character_,
      sample_host %in% c("Bird", "Migratory birds") ~ NA_character_,
      sample_host == "Coturnix" ~ "Quail",
      TRUE ~ sample_host),
    bird_category_basis = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(species_source_reported) ~ "source-reported species with consistent identifiers",
      is.na(bird_category) ~ identity_review_status,
      TRUE ~ "original broad source label; species not established by this curation"))
stopifnot(nrow(s1_revision) == 2658L,
  all(s1_revision$source_summary_included),
  sum(s1_revision$project_id == "PRJNA1034280") == 7L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(s1_revision$sample_accession) == 2653L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(s1_revision$project_id) == 28L)
df_scope_counts <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  "Full source inventory" = s1_revision,
  "Retail chicken meat" = s1_revision |> dplyr::filter(project_id == "PRJNA1034280"),
  "Included source inventory" = s1_revision |> dplyr::filter(source_summary_included),
  .id = "record_set") |>
  dplyr::group_by(record_set, input_record_type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(records = dplyr::n(), unique_runs = dplyr::n_distinct(run_accession),
    unique_biosamples = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_accession),
    projects = dplyr::n_distinct(project_id), .groups = "drop")
df_project_record_counts <- s1_revision |>
  dplyr::group_by(project_id, source_summary_included) |>
  dplyr::summarise(records = dplyr::n(), unique_runs = dplyr::n_distinct(run_accession),
    unique_biosamples = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_accession), .groups = "drop")
readr::write_tsv(s1_revision, path_target("source-metadata-reviewed.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_scope_counts, path_target("source-scope-counts.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_project_record_counts, path_target("source-project-record-counts.tsv"))

field_notes <- tibble::tribble(~field, ~meaning,
  "Status", "Source inventory preserving the submitted row set. Archival identifier evidence is distinguished from an unavailable historical input manifest.",
  "Original five columns", "Preserved verbatim. study_id can be a run accession or an internal source-study identifier.",
  "run_accession", "Original run identifier from study_id or exact matched metadata sample_id; all linked project IDs checked against runinfo. This does not establish the input reads used to produce a reused assembly.",
  "run_accession_source", "Distinguishes original study_id accessions from accessions recovered by matching all five S1 columns to the unique source metadata record.",
  "observed_source_labels / assembly_label_evidence", "Exact labels in the retained contig-to-assembly map, joined by stored run ID or a unique sample-name alias. Several aliases may map to one metadata record. A missing match does not imply exclusion or zero processing.",
  "retained_contigs_with_exact_label_match", "Contig records linked through the original mapping and unique metadata label. Unmapped contigs and ambiguous labels are not assigned by neighboring rows.",
  "assembly_sources", "All observed source labels in the original map, including labels without a unique S1/metadata match. These describe the available assembly records, not the complete historical processing cohort.",
  "bioproject_accession", "Original project identifiers matching BioProject accession syntax; registry lookup status is separate.",
  "source_sample_identifier", "Exact sample_id from the unique local metadata record matched to the original S1 fields.",
  "input_record_type", "Distinguishes run records from reused assemblies documented in the source workbook.",
  "library_* / instrument_*", "Fields copied by exact run accession from the local ENA runinfo snapshot. For reused assemblies these describe the metadata-associated source run, not verified assembly input. Source-paper protocols are not copied to all project runs.",
  "run_metadata_status", "Distinguishes direct run records from recovered source run IDs for reused assemblies whose actual assembly-to-read linkage remains unverified.",
  "source_workbook_*", "Original project_id-sheet action/comment fields; these historical notes do not override source records or decide final eligibility.",
  "publication_doi / publication_pmid", "Verified project-level article associations; full titles, evidence URLs, linkage notes and check date are in project_publications. Missing entries mean publication not identified, not unpublished.",
  "eligibility_review", "Records assay/source/inclusion questions and retained sampling contexts. All original rows remain in this inventory; actual experimental protocols and historical processing remain incompletely reconstructed.",
  "source_summary_included / source_scope_status", "TRUE for all 2,658 source records, including seven retail chicken-meat records (PRJNA1034280). The flag denotes inclusion in source summaries; sampling material, historical processing and biological independence retain their separate evidence scopes.",
  "bird_category / bird_category_basis", "Current broad category used in figures, S3 and release metadata. Source-reported species override old labels when identifiers agree. Fifteen conflicting identifiers and 22 Bird-only source records have no assigned category. Other original broad labels remain provisional; Pigeon and Quail do not establish exact species. Quail corresponds to the original Coturnix label.",
  "scope_counts / project_record_counts", "Counts of inventory records, distinct run accessions and distinct BioSample accessions. Reused-assembly run IDs identify associated metadata; the input-read linkage remains unresolved. Animal and farm independence require separate evidence.",
  "source_inventory", "All 2,670 unique local metadata records, including the 12 Grus records absent from S1. Contig counts are associated at study_id level; repeated internal study IDs share counts.",
  "registry_linked_pmids", "Publication links returned by the ENA project record; relevance to the source study still requires verification.",
  "species_source_reported / collection_origin_source_reported", "Species and collection-origin values are source-reported assignments supported by consistent identifiers. Blank values have reasons in identity_review_status: uncurated records, unresolved source fields or conflicting identifiers. Wild-bird field sampling records the source-study description; individual birds and a complete domestic/wild classification remain unverified.",
  "identity_review_status / reported_host_label", "Curation state and the exact host label in the reviewed source. For identifier conflicts, reported_host_label is the candidate attached to the source BioSample and species_source_reported remains blank. The original sample_host column is preserved separately; it may disagree with the reviewed species.",
  "collection_context / identity_evidence_scope / identity_evidence_url", "Sample-linked collection context, evidence granularity and source URL; curation rows attach to S1 by exact project, run, BioSample and sample-name keys. External-source matching criteria and conflicts are recorded in identity_evidence_scope.",
  "project_publications: reported_collection_context / host_context_scope / host_identity_note", "Project-level sampling information and remaining identity questions. Project context does not assign individual species or establish a complete domestic/wild classification.")
writexl::write_xlsx(list(samples = s1_revision, field_notes = field_notes,
  record_counts = df_metadata_flow, duplicate_records = df_metadata_duplicates,
  scope_counts = df_scope_counts, project_record_counts = df_project_record_counts,
  source_inventory = df_metadata_provenance, project_publications = publications,
  assembly_sources = df_observed_labels),
  path_target("source-metadata-audit.xlsx"))
s1_author_check <- s1_revision |>
  dplyr::left_join(publications |> dplyr::select(project_id, publication_title,
    reported_collection_context, host_context_scope, host_identity_note),
    by = "project_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::transmute(`Run accession` = run_accession,
    `BioProject accession` = project_id, sample_name,
    sample_host_original = sample_host, geo_loc_name_country,
    PMID_project_link = publication_pmid, Publication_project_link = publication_title,
    `Original study_id` = study_id, `Input record type` = input_record_type,
    `Run accession evidence` = run_accession_source,
    `Related PMID` = ifelse(project_id == "PRJNA723283", "34326826", NA_character_),
    `Review note` = eligibility_review, `BioSample accession` = sample_accession,

    collection_origin_source_reported, collection_context,
    reported_collection_context, host_context_scope, host_identity_note,

stopifnot(nrow(s1_author_check) == nrow(s1_revision),
  identical(s1_author_check$`Run accession`, s1_revision$run_accession))
author_check_notes <- tibble::tribble(~Item, ~Meaning,
  "Status", "Author-review source inventory; source eligibility and historical input flags remain explicit.",
  "Row identity", "All 2,658 inventory rows and their order are preserved; Original study_id retains the submitted identifier.",
  "Publication scope", "Project associations are distinguished from exact sample-alias crosswalks for PRJEB22062 and PRJNA861719.",
  "Species and context", "Species curation, broad categories and project sampling context retain distinct evidence scopes.",
  "Related PMID", "For PRJNA723283, 34326826 describes the related 16S paper; the main project PMID describes the WGS paper.",
  "Source audit SHA256", sha256_metadata(path_target("source-metadata-audit.xlsx")))
writexl::write_xlsx(list(reviewed_inventory = s1_author_check,
  readme = author_check_notes), path_target("table-s1-author-check.xlsx"))
knitr::kable(df_metadata_flow)
knitr::kable(df_eligibility_projects)
knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(rows_preserved = nrow(s1_revision),
  run_accession_rows = sum(!is.na(s1_revision$run_accession)),
```

## Supplementary source table

Table S1 presents accession numbers, bird categories, available species labels,
project sampling context and publications.

```{r}
#| label: supplementary-source-table
#| cache: false
# Exact project joins and column projection are O(n + m); rows retain input order.
df_s1_export <- readr::read_tsv(path_target("source-metadata-reviewed.tsv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c", source_summary_included = "l"))
df_s1_projects <- readr::read_tsv(path_target("source-project-publications.tsv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"))
df_s1_locations <- readxl::read_excel(here::here(path_raw, "pc028e3-metadata.xlsx"),
  col_types = "text") |>
  dplyr::distinct(sample_id, geo_loc_name)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_s1_projects$project_id),
  !anyDuplicated(df_s1_locations$sample_id))
df_s1_submission <- df_s1_export |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_s1_locations, by = c(source_sample_identifier = "sample_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_s1_projects |>
    dplyr::select(project_id, publication_title),
    by = "project_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    `Run accession` = run_accession,
    `BioProject accession` = project_id,
    `BioSample accession` = sample_accession,
    `Sample name` = sample_name,
    `Bird category` = dplyr::coalesce(bird_category, "Bird (unspecified)"),
    `Species (where reported)` = species_source_reported,
    Country = geo_loc_name_country,
    `Location (geo_loc_name)` = geo_loc_name,
    `Project sampling context` = dplyr::case_when(
      project_id == "PRJEB22062" ~ "Pooled broiler feces; farm/flock sampling",
      project_id %in% c("PRJNA556790", "PRJNA563508") ~ "Wild-bird field sampling",
      project_id == "PRJNA1035987" ~ "Live poultry market; rearing origin unspecified",
      project_id == "PRJNA1034280" ~ "Retail chicken meat; food-product metagenomes",
      project_id %in% c("PRJNA717910", "PRJNA861719") ~ "Quail housing/farm study",
      project_id == "PRJNA723283" ~ "Linwu duck experiment",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    PMID = publication_pmid,
    Publication = ifelse(is.na(publication_title), "Publication not identified",
      paste0(publication_title, ". https://doi.org/", publication_doi)),
    `Source summary included` = source_summary_included,
    Notes = dplyr::case_when(
      project_id == "PRJNA1034280" ~ eligibility_review,
      input_record_type == "reused assembly recorded in source workbook" ~
        paste0("Reused assembly; internal source ID: ", study_id,
          "; associated run assay: ", library_strategy, "; input reads unresolved."),
      library_strategy == "AMPLICON" ~ "Archive assay: AMPLICON; eligibility unresolved.",
      identity_review_status == "BioSample matched; publication alias conflicts with registry" ~
        "Species unresolved: conflicting sample identifiers.",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))
stopifnot(nrow(df_s1_submission) == nrow(df_s1_export),
  ncol(df_s1_submission) == 13L,
  identical(df_s1_submission$`Run accession`, df_s1_export$run_accession))
df_s1_notes <- tibble::tribble(~Field, ~Definition,
  "Scope", "Source inventory: 2,658 records, 2,658 distinct runs and 2,653 BioSamples. Each row describes an archive record; a BioSample may contain pooled material or have multiple sequencing runs.",
  "Run accession / BioProject accession / BioSample accession", "Archive identifiers. Runs associated with reused assemblies identify the linked source metadata; their connection to the actual assembly input reads remains unresolved, as recorded in Notes.",
  "Bird category", "Broad source category used in Figures 1–3 and Table S3. Duck and Goose can describe wild or farmed birds. Bird (unspecified) denotes an unresolved category. Figure 1 shows each category; Figure 2 combines Swan, Crane, Greenshank and Egret as Other waterbirds; Figure 3 groups Quail, Pigeon, Swan, Crane, Greenshank, Egret and Bird (unspecified) as Other birds.",
  "Location (geo_loc_name)", "Original geo_loc_name text from the source BioSample metadata, joined by source_sample_identifier to sample_id in the source metadata workbook. Geographic resolution varies among country, province and city. Blank cells indicate that the source field has no value.",
  "Species (where reported)", "Scientific names supported by matching identifiers in examined source metadata. Blank cells indicate that the species has not been established for this table. Source-reported identification is retained at its stated resolution.",
  "Species sources", "PRJNA556790 species labels derive from Wang et al. (2026), https://doi.org/10.1002/advs.74581; conflicting sample identifiers remain unresolved. Gallus gallus labels derive from matched BioSample records. PRJNA563508 source tables report Bird without a species name.",
  "Project sampling context", "Sampling setting reported for the source project. It does not establish the identity, husbandry or migratory behavior of each individual animal. Blank cells indicate that context has not been established for this table.",
  "PMID / Publication", "Associated source-project publications. PMID is blank when unavailable; Publication not identified means that an associated paper was not established. For PRJNA723283, the listed paper describes WGS; related PMID 34326826 describes 16S data under the same project.",
  "Source summary included", "TRUE for all 2,658 records, corresponding to 2,653 BioSamples across 28 projects. Seven retail chicken-meat records are included with their food-product sampling context. Assay and historical-input limitations remain in Notes.",
  "Repeated and pooled samples", "PRJEB22062 has 179 runs corresponding to 178 BioSamples and pooled farm/flock samples. ERR2241700 and ERR2245455 share SAMEA104467203. PRJNA748109 contains three further BioSamples with multiple runs.",
  "Notes", "Concise qualifications affecting interpretation of the source, accession or species. Blank notes do not certify complete metadata or independent biological replication.")
writexl::write_xlsx(list(samples = df_s1_submission, notes = df_s1_notes),
  path_target("table-s1-metadata.xlsx"))
knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(records = nrow(df_s1_submission),
  columns = ncol(df_s1_submission), sheets = 2L))
```

## Figures 1–3: source records, catalog composition and near-complete lengths

Source associations use retained members, the original assembly map and unique
metadata keys. Missing joins remain unresolved. An archival label association
describes the available records; it does not verify historical processing,
sampling independence, animal identity or library eligibility. All length panels
use the same near-complete representative set as Figure 5. Joins and counts are
linear in the number of records; sorting is O(n log n). Outputs are recomputed
within this step without a cache.

```{r}
#| label: source-figures-data
#| cache: false
con_summary <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_catalog_summary <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con_summary, paste("SELECT vOTU_id, contig_repid,",
  "original_representative_id, contig_length, checkv_completeness,",
  "checkv_contamination, checkv_quality_score, vc_id, lifestyle",
  "FROM contig_annotation_filtered_vOTU"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_summary)
df_bird_key <- s1_revision |>
  dplyr::transmute(metadata_sample_id = source_sample_identifier,
    bird_category = ifelse(source_summary_included, bird_category, NA_character_),
    bird_category_basis, source_summary_included, source_scope_status,
    run_accession, sample_accession, project_id, species_source_reported)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_bird_key$metadata_sample_id))
df_member_sources <- df_source_members |>
  dplyr::filter(record_set == "retained") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_label_keys, by = c("input_branch", "source_label"),
    relationship = "many-to-one", na_matches = "never") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_bird_key, by = "metadata_sample_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one", na_matches = "never") |>
  dplyr::select(contig_id, vOTU_id, recorded_assembly_id, source_label,
    metadata_sample_id, dplyr::all_of(setdiff(names(df_bird_key), "metadata_sample_id")))
stopifnot(nrow(df_member_sources) == 114375, !anyDuplicated(df_member_sources$contig_id),
  setequal(df_member_sources$vOTU_id, df_catalog_summary$vOTU_id))
df_votu_sources <- df_member_sources |>
  dplyr::group_by(vOTU_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(retained_members = dplyr::n(),
    metadata_matched_members = sum(!is.na(source_scope_status)),
    assigned_members = sum(!is.na(bird_category)),
    unresolved_members = sum(is.na(bird_category)),
    source_groups = paste(sort(unique(stats::na.omit(dplyr::if_else(bird_category %in%
      c("Chicken", "Duck", "Goose"), bird_category,
      dplyr::if_else(is.na(bird_category), NA_character_, "Other birds"))))), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(observed_groups = ifelse(source_groups == "", 0L,
      stringr::str_count(source_groups, ";") + 1L),
    source_status = dplyr::case_when(assigned_members == 0 ~ "Unresolved for all members",
      unresolved_members == 0 ~ "Assigned for all members",
      TRUE ~ "Assigned for some members"))
df_source_pairs <- df_member_sources |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(bird_category)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(vOTU_id, bird_category)
df_near_complete <- df_catalog_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(checkv_completeness > 90, checkv_contamination <= 5)
stopifnot(nrow(df_near_complete) == 12939,
  setequal(df_near_complete$vOTU_id, df_fig5$vOTU_id))
df_source_lengths <- df_source_pairs |>
  dplyr::inner_join(df_near_complete, by = "vOTU_id", relationship = "many-to-one")
df_inventory_included <- s1_revision |> dplyr::filter(source_summary_included)
df_inventory_counts <- df_inventory_included |>
  dplyr::mutate(sample_host = dplyr::coalesce(bird_category, "Bird (unspecified)")) |>
  dplyr::count(sample_host, name = "records")
df_country_counts <- df_inventory_included |> dplyr::count(geo_loc_name_country, name = "records")
df_quality_counts <- df_catalog_summary |>
  dplyr::count(checkv_quality_score, name = "vOTUs") |>
  dplyr::mutate(quality = factor(c("Complete", "High", "Medium", "Low")[checkv_quality_score],
    levels = c("Complete", "High", "Medium", "Low")))
df_source_counts_plot <- df_source_pairs |> dplyr::count(bird_category, name = "vOTUs")
df_source_status <- df_votu_sources |> dplyr::count(source_status, name = "vOTUs")
df_source_breadth <- df_votu_sources |>
  dplyr::count(observed_groups, source_status, name = "vOTUs")
df_vc_counts <- df_catalog_summary |> dplyr::count(vc_id, name = "vOTUs") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(vOTUs), vc_id)
df_lifestyle_counts <- df_catalog_summary |> dplyr::count(lifestyle, name = "vOTUs")
readr::write_tsv(df_member_sources, path_target("figure-source-members.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_votu_sources, path_target("figure-source-votus.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_source_lengths, path_target("figure2-near-complete-source-lengths.tsv"))
# Keep the submitted annotation rows, with explicit representative and source
# provenance. Study labels are reconstructed for the selected member only;
# vOTU-level member coverage remains a separate field.
# Three submitted rows store missing taxonomy as the text "NA"; read it as missing
# so S3 matches the release representation.
df_s3 <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "supplementary",
  "Supplementary table S3.xlsx"), skip = 1, na = c("", "NA"))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_s3$contig_id),
  setequal(df_s3$contig_id, df_catalog_summary$contig_repid))
df_s3_revision <- df_s3 |>
  dplyr::select(-study_id, -contig_repid) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_catalog_summary |>
    dplyr::select(vOTU_id, contig_repid, original_representative_id),
    by = c("contig_id" = "contig_repid"), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(contig_repid = contig_id) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_member_sources |>
    dplyr::select(-vOTU_id, -source_label),
    by = "contig_id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_metadata_unique |>
    dplyr::select(metadata_sample_id = sample_id, study_id),
    by = "metadata_sample_id", relationship = "many-to-one", na_matches = "never") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_votu_sources, by = "vOTU_id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::relocate(vOTU_id, contig_id, contig_repid, original_representative_id, study_id)
stopifnot(nrow(df_s3_revision) == nrow(df_s3),
  identical(df_s3_revision$contig_id, df_s3$contig_id), !anyNA(df_s3_revision$vOTU_id))
# Rank fields report classifier placeholders as unassigned; archived labels remain
# in archived_lineage. The release uses the same rule.
taxonomy_rank_columns <- c("realm", "kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus",
  "species")
standard_rank <- function(x) {
  dplyr::if_else(grepl("^\\[", x), "unassigned", dplyr::na_if(x, ""))
}
s3_rank_columns <- intersect(taxonomy_rank_columns, names(df_s3_revision))
df_s3_revision$archived_lineage <- do.call(paste, c(lapply(df_s3_revision[s3_rank_columns],
  function(x) dplyr::coalesce(as.character(x), "")), sep = ";"))
df_s3_revision <- df_s3_revision |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(s3_rank_columns),
    ~ standard_rank(as.character(.x)))) |>
  dplyr::relocate(archived_lineage, .after = dplyr::all_of(dplyr::last(s3_rank_columns)))
stopifnot(!any(vapply(df_s3_revision[s3_rank_columns], function(x) any(grepl("^\\[", x)),
  logical(1))))
df_s3_notes <- tibble::tribble(~field, ~meaning,
  "Scope", "All 61,608 selected representatives, including every quality tier. Annotation values and row order are retained from submitted S3; taxonomy rank fields report classifier placeholders as unassigned.",
  "archived_lineage", "Archived realm-to-genus labels separated by semicolons, including classifier placeholders such as [Novel_Family]_{class}_Caudoviricetes.",
  "contig_id / contig_repid", "Selected member exported in the corrected catalog; both columns identify the same sequence.",
  "original_representative_id / vc_*", "Original clustering sequence and its archived vConTACT3 annotations. vc_novel_genus marks a genus-level cluster without reference members in the archived network; operational flags do not establish sequence novelty or formal taxonomic rank.",
  "study_id / metadata_sample_id / run_accession / sample_accession", "Exact archival association for the selected member. Blank means unresolved. Historical input-read linkage and biological independence remain incompletely reconstructed.",
  "bird_category / bird_category_basis / species_source_reported", "Reviewed category and source-reported species for the selected member, using the same metadata table as S1 and the release. Conflicting identifiers and Bird-only records remain unassigned. Other broad labels retain their stated evidence level.",
  "source_summary_included / source_scope_status", "Source-scope status of the matched inventory record. All source records, including seven retail chicken-meat records, are included. Historical input and assay questions remain explicit.",
  "recorded_assembly_id", "Assembly identifier from the original retained map; blank if the contig has no mapping.",
  "retained_members / metadata_matched_members / assigned_members / unresolved_members / source_status", "Source coverage across all retained members. A metadata match can have an unassigned bird category. Assigned and unresolved counts refer to categories; both sum to retained_members.",
  "source_groups / observed_groups", "Observed Chicken, Duck, Goose and Other birds groups across matched members. Missing associations can underestimate breadth.",
  "Unknown categories", "Bird-only source records and conflicting identifiers contribute no known source group. Their original labels remain in S1.")
writexl::write_xlsx(list(annotations = df_s3_revision, field_notes = df_s3_notes),
  path_target("table-s3-annotations.xlsx"))
jsonlite::write_json(list(inventory_bird = df_inventory_counts, inventory_country = df_country_counts,
  inventory_records = nrow(s1_revision), included_records = nrow(df_inventory_included),
  inventory_unique_runs = dplyr::n_distinct(s1_revision$run_accession),
  inventory_unique_biosamples = dplyr::n_distinct(s1_revision$sample_accession),
  included_unique_runs = dplyr::n_distinct(df_inventory_included$run_accession),
  included_unique_biosamples = dplyr::n_distinct(df_inventory_included$sample_accession),
  scope_counts = df_scope_counts, project_record_counts = df_project_record_counts,
  category_changes = s1_revision |> dplyr::count(sample_host, bird_category, name = "records"),
  metadata_matched_members = sum(!is.na(df_member_sources$source_scope_status)),
  quality = df_quality_counts, source_associations = df_source_counts_plot,
  source_status = df_source_status, observed_source_breadth = df_source_breadth,
  near_complete_votus = nrow(df_near_complete), source_length_rows = nrow(df_source_lengths),
  near_complete_length_range = range(df_near_complete$contig_length),
  near_complete_over_200kb = sum(df_near_complete$contig_length > 200000),
  near_complete_with_source = dplyr::n_distinct(df_source_lengths$vOTU_id),
  members_with_source = sum(!is.na(df_member_sources$bird_category)),
  members_without_source = sum(is.na(df_member_sources$bird_category)),
  vc_count = nrow(df_vc_counts), largest_vcs = head(df_vc_counts, 10),
  lifestyles = df_lifestyle_counts,
  source_interpretation = "Archival label-to-metadata associations; unresolved members remain explicit. These counts do not bound uncertainty in historical processing or biological source identity."),
  path_target("figures123-summary.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
```

## Source metadata in the release

The release includes the source inventory and retained-member associations used
in S1, S3 and Figures 1–3. Source groups describe broad bird categories, with
unresolved identities represented explicitly.

```{r}
#| label: source-release-sync
#| cache: false
df_release_sources <- df_member_sources |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(bird_category)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(vOTU_id, bird_category) |>
  dplyr::summarise(retained_members = dplyr::n(),
    source_inventory_records = dplyr::n_distinct(metadata_sample_id),
    run_accessions = dplyr::n_distinct(run_accession),
    biosample_accessions = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_accession), .groups = "drop")
df_source_wide <- df_release_sources |>
  dplyr::select(vOTU_id, bird_category, retained_members) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = bird_category, values_from = retained_members,
    names_glue = "source_{bird_category}_members", values_fill = 0L)
source_columns <- setdiff(names(df_source_wide), "vOTU_id")
con_source_release <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),
  file.path(path_release, "AvianViromeDB.sqlite"), flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_release_before <- DBI::dbReadTable(con_source_release, "vOTU_annotation")
legacy_source_fields <- c(grep("^host_", names(df_release_before), value = TRUE), "vOTU_prevalence")
df_legacy_sources <- if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con_source_release, "legacy_bird_source_annotations")) {
  DBI::dbReadTable(con_source_release, "legacy_bird_source_annotations")
} else {
  df_release_before |> dplyr::select(vOTU_id, dplyr::all_of(legacy_source_fields))
}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_source_release)
con_work_columns <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"),
  flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
biological_columns <- setdiff(DBI::dbListFields(con_work_columns,
  "contig_annotation_filtered_vOTU"),
  c(grep("^host_", DBI::dbListFields(con_work_columns,
    "contig_annotation_filtered_vOTU"), value = TRUE), "vOTU_prevalence"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_work_columns)
df_release_reviewed <- df_release_before |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(biological_columns)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_votu_sources, by = "vOTU_id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_source_wide, by = "vOTU_id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(source_columns), ~ dplyr::coalesce(.x, 0L)))
# archived_lineage keeps the archived realm-to-species labels; rank fields report
# classifier placeholders as unassigned. Later runs rebuild from archived_lineage.
archived_lineage <- if ("archived_lineage" %in% names(df_release_before)) {
  df_release_before$archived_lineage
} else {
  do.call(paste, c(lapply(df_release_before[taxonomy_rank_columns],
    function(x) dplyr::coalesce(x, "")), sep = ";"))
}
archived_ranks <- stringr::str_split_fixed(archived_lineage, ";", length(taxonomy_rank_columns))
stopifnot(!anyNA(archived_lineage), stringr::str_count(archived_lineage, ";") ==
  length(taxonomy_rank_columns) - 1L)
for (i in seq_along(taxonomy_rank_columns)) {
  df_release_reviewed[[taxonomy_rank_columns[i]]] <- standard_rank(archived_ranks[, i])
}
df_release_reviewed$archived_lineage <- archived_lineage
rank_fields_valid <- vapply(taxonomy_rank_columns, function(rank) {
  before <- df_release_before[[rank]]
  after <- df_release_reviewed[[rank]]
  all((is.na(before) & is.na(after)) | (!is.na(before) & !is.na(after) & before == after) |
    (!is.na(before) & grepl("^\\[", before) & after %in% "unassigned"))
}, logical(1))
unchanged_columns <- setdiff(biological_columns, taxonomy_rank_columns)
stopifnot(identical(df_release_reviewed[, unchanged_columns],
    df_release_before[, unchanged_columns]), all(rank_fields_valid),
  !any(vapply(df_release_reviewed[taxonomy_rank_columns], function(x) any(grepl("^\\[", x)),
    logical(1))),
  nrow(df_release_reviewed) == 61608,
  all(rowSums(df_release_reviewed[, source_columns]) == df_release_reviewed$assigned_members),
  all(df_release_reviewed$assigned_members + df_release_reviewed$unresolved_members ==
    df_release_reviewed$retained_members))
path_source_stage <- path_target("scratch", "source-release-stage")
dir.create(path_source_stage, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
stopifnot(file.copy(file.path(path_release, "AvianViromeDB.sqlite"),
  file.path(path_source_stage, "AvianViromeDB.sqlite"), overwrite = TRUE))
source_tables <- list(vOTU_annotation = df_release_reviewed,
  source_inventory = s1_revision, vOTU_source_members = df_member_sources,
  vOTU_bird_sources = df_release_sources, legacy_bird_source_annotations = df_legacy_sources)
con_source_stage <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),
  file.path(path_source_stage, "AvianViromeDB.sqlite"))
DBI::dbWithTransaction(con_source_stage, {
  for (table_name in names(source_tables)) {
    DBI::dbWriteTable(con_source_stage, table_name, source_tables[[table_name]], overwrite = TRUE)
  }
})
stopifnot(DBI::dbGetQuery(con_source_stage, "PRAGMA integrity_check")[[1]] == "ok")
for (table_name in names(source_tables)) {
  stopifnot(DBI::dbGetQuery(con_source_stage,
    paste("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM", table_name))$n == nrow(source_tables[[table_name]]))
  readr::write_tsv(source_tables[[table_name]],
    file.path(path_source_stage, paste0(table_name, ".tsv.gz")))
}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con_source_stage)
description <- c("AvianViromeDB: local corrected release with reviewed source metadata",
  "vOTU_id retains the cluster identity; contig_repid identifies the exported representative.",
  "original_representative_id links the archived network annotations.",
  "source_*_members counts retained member contigs with a known bird category; source groups can overlap.",
  "retained_members = assigned_members + unresolved_members; metadata_matched_members can include unknown categories.",
  "source_groups / observed_groups summarize Chicken, Duck, Goose and Other birds among assigned members.",
  "source_inventory preserves every S1 record and original label; all 2,658 records, including seven retail chicken-meat records, have source_summary_included=1.",
  "The source inventory retains assay/input questions. Unique run and BioSample counts describe archive identifiers.",
  "vOTU_source_members provides exact archival joins and explicit gaps; vOTU_bird_sources gives category-level counts.",
  "legacy_bird_source_annotations preserves historical host_* and vOTU_prevalence fields for provenance only.",
  "Taxonomy rank fields (realm to species) report unassigned where the archived classifier output has a placeholder label such as [Novel_Family]_{class}_Caudoviricetes; archived_lineage keeps the archived realm-to-species labels separated by semicolons.",
  "vc_* fields are archived vConTACT3 outputs for the original network representatives; vc_novel_genus marks genus-level clusters without reference members in that network and does not designate a new taxon.",
  "Bird source fields describe sampled animals; prokaryotic host predictions are in a separate table.",
  "Host and gene tables retain source_contig_id and is_representative; the protein FASTA contains representative proteins.",
  "All sequence and member-level functional-annotation files retain their pre-curation bytes.")
writeLines(description, file.path(path_source_stage, "db_description.txt"))
immutable_files <- c("vOTUs.fasta.gz", "vOTU_proteins.faa.gz",
  "vOTU_prokyriotic_hosts.tsv.gz", "gene_annotations.tar.gz")
for (filename in immutable_files) {
  stopifnot(sha256_file(file.path(path_release, filename)) ==
    release_manifest$files[[filename]]$sha256)
}
for (filename in list.files(path_source_stage)) {
  stopifnot(file.rename(file.path(path_source_stage, filename), file.path(path_release, filename)))
}
source_input_files <- c(identity_evidence = identity_file,
  reviewed_metadata = path_target("source-metadata-reviewed.tsv"),
  source_members = path_target("figure-source-members.tsv"))
release_manifest$source_curation <- list(
  generator = "analyses/100-reviewer-revision.qmd", generator_sha256 = sha256_file(here::here("100-reviewer-revision.qmd")),
  inputs = lapply(source_input_files, function(path) list(path = path, sha256 = sha256_file(path))),
  scope_counts = df_scope_counts, biological_annotation_columns_unchanged = unchanged_columns,
  taxonomy_standardization = list(rank_columns = taxonomy_rank_columns,
    placeholder_pattern = "^\\[", reported_as = "unassigned", archived_column = "archived_lineage",
    standardized_fields = sum(stringr::str_detect(archived_ranks, "^\\["))),
  immutable_files = immutable_files,
  semantics = "Source counts are archival associations with explicit unresolved categories and scope flags; biological independence and historical processing remain unverified.")
release_manifest$catalog_attributes_unchanged <- FALSE
for (table_name in names(source_tables)) {
  release_manifest$counts[[table_name]] <- nrow(source_tables[[table_name]])
}
release_files <- setdiff(list.files(path_release), "manifest.json")
release_manifest$files <- stats::setNames(lapply(release_files, function(filename) {
  path <- file.path(path_release, filename)
  list(bytes = unname(file.info(path)$size), sha256 = sha256_file(path))
}), release_files)
jsonlite::write_json(release_manifest, path_manifest, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

## Figure 6: gene-content tree and network modules

The display reads the stored dendrogram and module assignments without rerunning
sequence inference or clustering. Each tree tip is matched by its archived query
identifier or reference accession. Network query identifiers are checked against
the catalog's original representative identifiers. The annotation track states
sequence-set membership. Module counts include an explicit unassigned category
in the supporting table. Tree reading, joins and summarization are O(n); no
pairwise distance matrix is constructed.

```{r}
#| label: network-figure-data
#| cache: false
path_network <- path_source("00-raw", "d12-vc3_hq")
path_tree <- file.path(path_network, "trees", "Duplodnaviria", "Duplodnaviria_1_tree.nw")
tree_archived <- ape::read.tree(path_tree)
df_assignments <- readr::read_csv(file.path(path_network, "final_assignments.csv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character())) |>
  dplyr::transmute(genome_name = GenomeName, reference_accession = RefSeqID,
    sequence_set = ifelse(Reference == "True", "Reference", "Catalog"),
    tree_label = ifelse(Reference == "True", RefSeqID, GenomeName))
df_nodes <- readr::read_csv(file.path(path_network, "cytoscape", "nodes_extracted.csv"),
  col_types = "cc") |> dplyr::rename(node_id = id, genome_name = GenomeName)
df_modules <- readr::read_csv(file.path(path_network, "cytoscape", "infomap100.csv"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character())) |>
  dplyr::transmute(node_id = name, module_id = `__infomapCluster100`)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_assignments$genome_name), !anyDuplicated(df_assignments$tree_label),
  !anyDuplicated(df_nodes$node_id), !anyDuplicated(df_modules$node_id),
  all(df_modules$node_id %in% df_nodes$node_id))
df_network <- df_nodes |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_assignments, by = "genome_name", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_modules, by = "node_id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_catalog_summary |>
    dplyr::select(original_representative_id, vOTU_id, contig_repid),
    by = c("genome_name" = "original_representative_id"), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_checkv_raw |> dplyr::transmute(genome_name = contig_id,
    network_sequence_length = contig_length, network_sequence_quality = checkv_quality,
    network_sequence_completeness = completeness, network_sequence_contamination = contamination),
    by = "genome_name", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(!anyNA(df_network$sequence_set),
  all(!is.na(df_network$vOTU_id[df_network$sequence_set == "Catalog"])),
  all(!is.na(df_network$network_sequence_quality[df_network$sequence_set == "Catalog"])),
  all(is.na(df_network$vOTU_id[df_network$sequence_set == "Reference"])))
df_tree_tips <- tibble::tibble(tree_label = tree_archived$tip.label,
  root_to_tip = ape::node.depth.edgelength(tree_archived)[seq_along(tree_archived$tip.label)]) |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_network, by = "tree_label", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_tree_tips$tree_label), !anyNA(df_tree_tips$sequence_set),
  all(tree_archived$edge.length >= 0))
# Collapse monophyletic subtrees solely for legibility. The partition follows
# the stored topology; Infomap modules are not used as clades. Terminal clades
# have at most 500 original tips. Every tip belongs to exactly one display group.
tip_count <- length(tree_archived$tip.label)
descendant_counts <- numeric(tip_count + tree_archived$Nnode)
descendant_counts[seq_len(tip_count)] <- 1
df_postorder_edges <- ape::reorder.phylo(tree_archived, "postorder")$edge
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_postorder_edges))) {
  parent <- df_postorder_edges[i, 1]; child <- df_postorder_edges[i, 2]
  descendant_counts[parent] <- descendant_counts[parent] + descendant_counts[child]
}
children <- split(tree_archived$edge[, 2], tree_archived$edge[, 1])
frontier <- integer(); stack <- tip_count + 1L
while (length(stack)) {
  node <- tail(stack, 1); stack <- head(stack, -1)
  if (descendant_counts[node] <= 500) frontier <- c(frontier, node) else
    stack <- c(stack, children[[as.character(node)]])
}
display_group <- integer(length(descendant_counts))
display_group[frontier] <- frontier
df_preorder_edges <- ape::reorder.phylo(tree_archived, "cladewise")$edge
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_preorder_edges))) {
  parent <- df_preorder_edges[i, 1]; child <- df_preorder_edges[i, 2]
  if (display_group[child] == 0L) display_group[child] <- display_group[parent]
}
df_tree_tips$display_node <- display_group[seq_len(tip_count)]
stopifnot(all(df_tree_tips$display_node > 0),
  sum(descendant_counts[frontier]) == tip_count,
  setequal(df_tree_tips$display_node, frontier))
df_display_clades <- df_tree_tips |> dplyr::group_by(display_node) |>
  dplyr::summarise(tips = dplyr::n(), catalog_tips = sum(sequence_set == "Catalog"),
    reference_tips = sum(sequence_set == "Reference"),
    tip_distance_min = min(root_to_tip), tip_distance_max = max(root_to_tip), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(node_distance = ape::node.depth.edgelength(tree_archived)[display_node])
stopifnot(all(df_display_clades$tips == descendant_counts[df_display_clades$display_node]))
df_module_counts <- df_network |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(module_id)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(module_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(catalog_nodes = sum(sequence_set == "Catalog"),
    reference_nodes = sum(sequence_set == "Reference"), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(composition = dplyr::case_when(catalog_nodes == 0 ~ "Reference only",
    reference_nodes == 0 ~ "Catalog only", TRUE ~ "Mixed"))
df_module_summary <- df_module_counts |>
  dplyr::group_by(composition) |>
  dplyr::summarise(modules = dplyr::n(), catalog_nodes = sum(catalog_nodes),
    reference_nodes = sum(reference_nodes), .groups = "drop")
root_span <- diff(range(df_tree_tips$root_to_tip)) / max(df_tree_tips$root_to_tip)
readr::write_tsv(df_tree_tips, path_target("figure6-tree-tips.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_display_clades, path_target("figure6-displayed-clades.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_network, path_target("figure6-network-nodes.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(df_module_counts, path_target("figure6-network-modules.tsv"))
jsonlite::write_json(list(tree_file = path_tree, tree_sha256 = sha256_metadata(path_tree),
  assignments_sha256 = sha256_metadata(file.path(path_network, "final_assignments.csv")),
  modules_sha256 = sha256_metadata(file.path(path_network, "cytoscape", "infomap100.csv")),
  tree_sequences = df_tree_tips |> dplyr::count(sequence_set),
  network_sequences = df_network |> dplyr::count(sequence_set),
  original_query_quality = df_network |> dplyr::filter(sequence_set == "Catalog") |>
    dplyr::count(network_sequence_quality),
  query_ids_differing_from_current_export = sum(df_network$genome_name != df_network$contig_repid,
    na.rm = TRUE),
  module_summary = df_module_summary,
  unassigned_nodes = df_network |> dplyr::filter(is.na(module_id)) |> dplyr::count(sequence_set),
  tree_root_to_tip_range = range(df_tree_tips$root_to_tip), relative_tip_span = root_span,
  display_tip_limit = 500, collapsed_clades = sum(df_display_clades$tips > 1),
  individually_shown_tips = sum(df_display_clades$tips == 1),
  ultrametric_default = ape::is.ultrametric(tree_archived),
  ultrametric_tolerance_1e5 = ape::is.ultrametric(tree_archived, tol = 1e-5),
  branch_display = "Stored topology and branch lengths; no equal-height forcing or distance recalculation.",
  query_identifier_basis = "Archived original_representative_id; current exported contig_repid retained as a separate column."),
  path_target("figure6-summary.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)
```

```{r}
df_ring <- p_tree$data |> dplyr::filter(isTip) |>

stopifnot(nrow(df_ring) == length(tree_archived$tip.label), !anyNA(df_ring$sequence_set))
```
