## Figure 8: a shared convention for enzyme and annotation labels

The supplied composite SVG contains editable panel-a text and an embedded image of
panel b. The separate panel-b SVG supplies its editable artwork. This formatting
step preserves existing identifiers and pathway geometry, replaces the enzyme
backgrounds with one box style, and adds a shared legend. It does not validate the
biochemical assignments. The sole text correction is “hydroloses” to “hydrolases”.

```{r}
#| label: figure8-paths
#| cache: false
Sys.setenv(
  FIGURE8_SOURCE = here::here("manuscript", "260309-npj", "figures"),
  FIGURE8_TARGET = path_target()
)
```

```{bash}
#| label: figure8-vector-style
#| cache: false
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import copy
import hashlib
import io
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import cairo
import gi
from PIL import Image

gi.require_version("Rsvg", "2.0")
from gi.repository import Rsvg

source = Path(os.environ["FIGURE8_SOURCE"])
target = Path(os.environ["FIGURE8_TARGET"])
assert source.is_absolute() and target.is_absolute()
ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
ET.register_namespace("", ns)
def tag(name):
    return f"{{{ns}}}{name}"

def text_of(node):
    return "".join(node.itertext())

inputs = {name: hashlib.sha256((source / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for name in ("figure8.svg", "figure8B.svg", "figure8.ai")}
# These selectors refer to the supplied artwork, not an arbitrary later figure.
assert inputs["figure8.svg"] == "dbb2a9beba4d87bbe3ac296c955609e3adfa9ddab9ccae5b8349271dd164e4d9"
assert inputs["figure8B.svg"] == "c9f251780de19467b3e67f9075b956974f264c9b71a9b48c1c1a05c02c71cf22"
a = ET.parse(source / "figure8.svg").getroot()
b = ET.parse(source / "figure8B.svg").getroot()
original_texts = [[text_of(n) for n in p.iter(tag("text"))]
                  for p in (a, b)]
box_style = {"fill": "#dceaf7", "stroke": "#466582", "stroke-width": "0.9"}
font = "font-family:Arial,'Liberation Sans',sans-serif;"
identifier_style = font + "font-size:16px;font-style:normal;fill:#9c3d10"
enzyme_style = font + "font-size:16px;font-style:normal;fill:#000"

# Replace the seven raster ellipse backgrounds while retaining their text.
parents = {child: parent for parent in a.iter() for child in parent}
images = list(a.iter(tag("image")))
assert len(images) == 8 and images[-1].get("width") == "3913"
for image in images[:-1]:
    assert image.get("width") == "297"
    match = re.fullmatch(r"translate\(([\d.]+) ([\d.]+)\) scale\(\.36\)",
                         image.get("transform"))
    assert match is not None
    x, y = map(float, match.groups())
    rect = ET.Element(tag("rect"), {
        "x": str(x + 2), "y": str(y + 1), "width": "103", "height": "28",
        "rx": "6", **box_style})
    parent = parents[image]
    index = list(parent).index(image)
    parent.remove(image)
    parent.insert(index, rect)
parents[images[-1]].remove(images[-1])
for node in list(a.iter(tag("text"))):
    if text_of(node) == "b":
        parents[node].remove(node)

# Panel-b enzyme boxes comprise five rectangles and two rounded paths.
b_rects = [n for n in b.iter(tag("rect")) if n.get("class") == "cls-26"]
b_paths = [n for n in b.iter(tag("path")) if n.get("class") == "cls-23"]
assert len(b_rects) == 5 and len(b_paths) == 2
for node in b_rects:
    node.attrib.pop("class")
    node.attrib.update({**box_style, "rx": "6", "ry": "6", "height": "28"})
for node, (x, y, width) in zip(b_paths, [(29.4, 411.96, 93.48), (197.64, 458.76, 93.6)]):
    node.tag = tag("rect")
    node.attrib.clear()
    node.attrib.update({"x": str(x), "y": str(y), "width": str(width),
                        "height": "28", "rx": "6", **box_style})

for panel, identifier_classes in [(a, {"cls-9", "cls-10"}),
                                   (b, {"cls-6", "cls-20"})]:
    for node in panel.iter(tag("text")):
        node.set("style", font)
        if node.get("class") in identifier_classes:
            node.set("style", identifier_style)
        if text_of(node).startswith("EC ") or node.get("class") in (
                {"cls-7", "cls-9"} if panel is b else set()):
            # Panel-b class-7 also contains the separate PFL-AE text fragments.
            node.set("style", enzyme_style)
        # Replace Abadi-specific tspan offsets with the uniform font's kerning.
        if panel is b and text_of(node) == "Cellulose":
            for child in list(node):
                node.remove(child)
            node.text = "Cellulose"
            node.set("transform", "translate(8 143.54)")
        if text_of(node) == "Glycoside hydroloses":
            for child in list(node):
                node.remove(child)
            node.text = "Glycoside hydrolases"

# Prefix both CSS classes and XML IDs so the source Illustrator clip paths
# remain independent when the panels share one SVG document.
for prefix, panel in [("a-", a), ("b-", b)]:
    for node in panel.iter():
        if "id" in node.attrib:
            node.set("id", prefix + node.get("id"))
        if "class" in node.attrib:
            node.set("class", " ".join(prefix + c for c in node.get("class").split()))
        for key, value in list(node.attrib.items()):
            node.set(key, value.replace("url(#", "url(#" + prefix))
        if node.tag == tag("style"):
            node.text = re.sub(r"\.cls-(\d+)", rf".{prefix}cls-\1", node.text)
            node.text = node.text.replace("url(#", "url(#" + prefix)

assert [text_of(n) for n in a.iter(tag("text"))] == [t for t in original_texts[0] if t != "b"]
assert [text_of(n) for n in b.iter(tag("text"))] == [
    t.replace("Glycoside hydroloses", "Glycoside hydrolases") for t in original_texts[1]]

width, height, width_mm = 990, 1052, 183
root = ET.Element(tag("svg"), {"viewBox": f"0 0 {width} {height}",
    "width": f"{width_mm}mm", "height": f"{width_mm * height / width:.6f}mm"})
ET.SubElement(root, tag("title")).text = "Figure 8. Biochemical context for putative viral metabolic annotations"
ET.SubElement(root, tag("rect"), {"width": str(width), "height": str(height), "fill": "white"})
for name, panel, transform in [("panel-a", a, "translate(0 0)"),
                               ("panel-b", b, "translate(20.92 416.8)")]:
    group = ET.SubElement(root, tag("g"), {"id": name, "transform": transform})
    group.extend(copy.deepcopy(list(panel)))
ET.SubElement(root, tag("text"), {"x": "20.92", "y": "422.8", "style": font,
    "font-size": "34"}).text = "b"
legend = ET.SubElement(root, tag("g"), {"id": "shared-legend"})
ET.SubElement(legend, tag("line"), {"x1": "21", "x2": "961", "y1": "974", "y2": "974",
    "stroke": "#c7c7c7", "stroke-width": "1"})
ET.SubElement(legend, tag("rect"), {"x": "21", "y": "986", "width": "115",
    "height": "28", "rx": "6", **box_style})
for x, y, label, style in [
    (29, 1006, "Enzyme label", enzyme_style),
    (151, 1006, "EC number / protein abbreviation", font),
    (484, 1006, "KO / GH", identifier_style),
    (572, 1006, "Annotation identifier", font),
    (21, 1040, "Other labels and arrows provide biochemical context.", font)]:
    ET.SubElement(legend, tag("text"), {"x": str(x), "y": str(y),
        "font-size": "16", "style": style}).text = label

ids = [n.get("id") for n in root.iter() if n.get("id")]
assert len(ids) == len(set(ids))
assert not list(root.iter(tag("image")))
# Existing non-box path geometry must survive the merge byte-for-byte.
for name, original in [("panel-a", "figure8.svg"), ("panel-b", "figure8B.svg")]:
    before = ET.parse(source / original).getroot()
    before_geometry = [(n.tag, dict(n.attrib)) for n in before.iter()
                       if n.tag in {tag("path"), tag("polyline"), tag("polygon")}
                       and not (name == "panel-b" and n.get("class") == "cls-23")]
    after = root.find(f".//{{{ns}}}g[@id='{name}']")
    after_geometry = [(n.tag, {k: (v[2:] if k == "class" else v) for k, v in n.attrib.items()})
                      for n in after.iter() if n.tag in {tag("path"), tag("polyline"), tag("polygon")}]
    assert before_geometry == after_geometry

stem = target / "figure8-consistent-labels"
svg = ET.tostring(root, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
stem.with_suffix(".svg").write_bytes(svg)
handle = Rsvg.Handle.new_from_data(svg)

def draw(surface, w, h):
    ctx = cairo.Context(surface)
    ctx.set_source_rgb(1, 1, 1)
    ctx.paint()
    viewport = Rsvg.Rectangle()
    viewport.x = viewport.y = 0
    viewport.width, viewport.height = w, h
    assert handle.render_document(ctx, viewport)

# Cairo retains vector geometry and embeds the fonts used by librsvg.
pdf_width = width_mm / 25.4 * 72
pdf_height = pdf_width * height / width
pdf = cairo.PDFSurface(str(stem.with_suffix(".pdf")), pdf_width, pdf_height)
draw(pdf, pdf_width, pdf_height)
pdf.finish()
for dpi in (300, 600):
    w = math.ceil(width_mm / 25.4 * dpi)
    h = round(w * height / width)
    surface = cairo.ImageSurface(cairo.FORMAT_ARGB32, w, h)
    draw(surface, w, h)
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    surface.write_to_png(buffer)
    rendered = Image.open(io.BytesIO(buffer.getvalue())).convert("RGB")
    if dpi == 300:
        rendered.save(str(stem) + "-preview.png", dpi=(dpi, dpi))
    else:
        rendered.save(stem.with_suffix(".tiff"), compression="tiff_lzw", dpi=(dpi, dpi))
    surface.finish()

assert all(hashlib.sha256((source / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sha
           for name, sha in inputs.items())
audit = {"inputs_sha256": inputs, "enzyme_boxes": {"a": 7, "b": 7},
         "original_text_nodes": [len(t) for t in original_texts],
         "text_changes": {"Glycoside hydroloses": "Glycoside hydrolases"},
         "label_layout_adjustments": ["Cellulose: uniform font kerning and arrow clearance"],
         "original_identifiers_preserved": True, "non_box_path_geometry_preserved": True,
         "embedded_raster_images": 0, "duplicate_xml_ids": 0,
         "width_mm": width_mm, "height_mm": width_mm * height / width,
         "scope": "Visual labeling only; biochemical assignments were not revalidated.",
         "outputs_sha256": {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                            for p in target.glob(stem.name + "*")}}
(target / "figure8-style-audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(audit, indent=2) + "\n")
print("Figure 8: original labels and pathway geometry retained; vector exports and previews written.")
PY
```

![Both panels use the same enzyme boxes and identifier typography.](data/100-reviewer-revision/figure8-consistent-labels-preview.png)

## Taxonomic annotation provenance

Representative identifiers link taxonomic annotations to tool outputs and the
fixed ICTV MSL41 name list. Sequence comparisons provide additional taxonomic
evidence in the corroboration analysis below.

```{r}
#| label: taxonomy-provenance-paths
#| cache: false
Sys.setenv(REVISION_ROOT = dirname(here::here()),
  REVISION_QMD = here::here("100-reviewer-revision.qmd"),
  TAXONOMY_OUT = path_target("remaining-evidence", "taxonomy"))
```

```{bash}
#| label: taxonomy-provenance
#| cache: false
python3 - <<'PYTAXONOMY'
"""Summarize archived taxonomic labels and their version-specific provenance."""

import os
import csv
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

RANKS = ("realm", "kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species")
QUALITY = {"1": "Complete", "2": "High-quality", "3": "Medium-quality",
           "4": "Low-quality", "5": "Not-determined", "9": "Other"}
ICTV_URL = ("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ICTV-Virus-Knowledgebase/"
            "ICTVdatabase/MSL41.v1_20260320/data/taxonomy_node_export.utf8.txt")


def read_tsv(path):
    opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
    with opener(path, "rt") as handle:
        return list(csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t"))


def write_tsv(path, rows, fields=None):
    rows = list(rows)
    with path.open("w") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fields or list(rows[0]),
                                delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def keyed(rows, key):
    index = {row[key]: row for row in rows}
    assert len(index) == len(rows), f"Duplicate identifiers in {key}"
    return index


def label_status(label):
    if label in ("", "NA", "NULL", "-", None):
        return "missing"
    return "placeholder" if label.startswith("[") else "named"


def main(root, out):
    paths = {
        "release": root / "analyses/data/100-reviewer-revision/release/vOTU_annotation.tsv.gz",
        "vitap": root / "analyses/data/00-raw/d09-taxonomy/taxonomy_vitap.tsv",
        "genomad": root / "analyses/data/00-raw/d09-taxonomy/genomad_summary.tsv",
        "formatted": root / "analyses/data/09-taxonomy/taxonomy_formatted.tsv",
        "genomad_vote": root / "analyses/data/00-raw/hpc/genomad/ccflt_annotate/ccflt_taxonomy.tsv",
        "ictv_current": out / "ictv-msl41-official-taxonomy.tsv",
        "ictv_history": out / "ictv-catalog-name-history.tsv",
    }
    release = read_tsv(paths["release"])
    # Provenance compares archived labels; the release rank fields report placeholders as unassigned.
    for row in release:
        archived = row["archived_lineage"].split(";")
        assert len(archived) == len(RANKS)
        row.update({rank: label or "NA" for rank, label in zip(RANKS, archived)})
    keyed(release, "vOTU_id")
    keyed(release, "contig_repid")
    vitap = keyed([r for r in read_tsv(paths["vitap"]) if "contig" in r["Genome_ID"]], "Genome_ID")
    genomad_rows = read_tsv(paths["genomad"])
    for row in genomad_rows:
        row["contig_id"] = row["seq_name"].split("|")[0]
    genomad = keyed(genomad_rows, "contig_id")
    formatted = keyed(read_tsv(paths["formatted"]), "contig_id")
    vote = keyed(read_tsv(paths["genomad_vote"]), "seq_name")
    official = read_tsv(paths["ictv_current"])
    history = read_tsv(paths["ictv_history"])
    latest_names = {}
    for item in history:
        key = (item["rank"], item["name"])
        if item["is_hidden"] == "0" and item["is_deleted"] == "0":
            if key not in latest_names or int(item["msl_release_num"]) > int(latest_names[key]["msl_release_num"]):
                latest_names[key] = item
    # All MSL41 export rows have is_official=0; the official release tag fixes scope.
    current = {(r["rank"], r["name"]): r for r in official
               if r["is_hidden"] == "0" and r["is_deleted"] == "0"}
    official_counts = Counter(r["rank"] for r in current.values())
    assert official_counts["species"] == 17554
    assert official_counts["family"] == 427 and official_counts["class"] == 50

    rank_counts, taxon_counts, confidence = Counter(), Counter(), Counter()
    comparison_counts, comparison_families, msl_counts = Counter(), Counter(), Counter()
    metrics = Counter()
    evidence, conflicts = [], []
    for row in release:
        cid, old_id = row["contig_repid"], row["original_representative_id"]
        source = {"1": "VITAP", "2": "geNomad"}.get(row["taxonomy_priority"], "missing")
        formatted_row, old_row = formatted.get(cid), formatted.get(old_id)
        v, g, gv = vitap.get(cid), genomad.get(cid), vote.get(cid)
        vl = dict(zip(reversed(RANKS), v["lineage"].split(";"))) if v else {}
        gl = dict(zip(RANKS[:6], g["taxonomy"].split(";")[1:])) if g else {}
        vc, vs = (v["Confidence_level"], v["lineage_score"]) if v else ("", "")
        changed = cid != old_id
        mismatch = [] if formatted_row is None else [k for k in (*RANKS, "taxonomy_priority")
            if ("" if row[k] == "NA" else row[k]) != formatted_row[k]]
        metrics["release_rows"] += 1
        metrics["representative_ids_changed"] += changed
        metrics["representatives_in_formatted_taxonomy"] += formatted_row is not None
        metrics["original_representatives_in_formatted_taxonomy"] += old_row is not None
        metrics["release_rows_disagreeing_with_current_contig_taxonomy"] += bool(mismatch)
        if source == "VITAP":
            assert v is not None
            confidence[("all", vc)] += 1
        if source == "geNomad":
            assert v is None and g is not None

        vf, gf = vl.get("family", ""), gl.get("family", "")
        vn, gn = label_status(vf) == "named", label_status(gf) == "named"
        comparison = ("both_named_same" if vn and gn and vf == gf else
                      "both_named_conflict" if vn and gn else
                      "VITAP_only_named" if vn else "geNomad_only_named" if gn else "neither_named")
        scope = "catalog_named_family" if label_status(row["family"]) == "named" else "catalog_family_unassigned"
        comparison_counts[(scope, comparison, QUALITY[row["checkv_quality_score"]], changed)] += 1
        comparison_families[(row["family"] if scope == "catalog_named_family" else "Unassigned", comparison)] += 1
        ev = {
            "vOTU_id": row["vOTU_id"], "current_representative_id": cid,
            "original_representative_id": old_id, "representative_changed": changed,
            "taxonomy_source": source, "taxonomy_priority": row["taxonomy_priority"],
            "matches_current_representative_taxonomy": formatted_row is not None and not mismatch,
            "vitap_row_available": v is not None, "genomad_row_available": g is not None,
            "vitap_confidence": vc, "vitap_lineage_score": vs,
            "vitap_family": vf, "genomad_family": gf, "family_comparison": comparison,
            "catalog_family_scope": scope, "original_family": old_row["family"] if old_row else "",
            "family_label_differs_from_original_representative": old_row is not None and old_row["family"] != row["family"],
            "original_class": old_row["class"] if old_row else "",
            "original_taxonomy_source": {"1": "VITAP", "2": "geNomad"}.get(old_row["taxonomy_priority"], "missing") if old_row else "missing",
            "checkv_quality_tier": QUALITY[row["checkv_quality_score"]],
            "checkv_completeness": row["checkv_completeness"],
            "checkv_contamination": row["checkv_contamination"],
            "genomad_archived_n_genes_with_taxonomy": gv["n_genes_with_taxonomy"] if gv else "",
            "genomad_archived_agreement": gv["agreement"] if gv else "",
            "genomad_archived_vote_lineage_matches_summary": gv["lineage"] == g["taxonomy"] if gv and g else "",
            "species_label_kind": "internal_operational_label" if row["species"].startswith("s.vOTU_") else label_status(row["species"]),
        }
        for rank in RANKS:
            status = label_status(row[rank])
            rank_counts[(rank, status, source)] += 1
            taxon_counts[(rank, row[rank], status, source)] += 1
            if source == "VITAP" and status == "named":
                confidence[(rank, vc)] += 1
            if old_row:
                metrics[f"changed_representative_{rank}_label_difference"] += changed and row[rank] != old_row[rank]
            ev[rank] = row[rank]
            ev[f"original_{rank}"] = old_row[rank] if old_row else ""
            msl_status = ("current_name_same_rank" if (rank, row[rank]) in current else
                          "absent_same_rank" if status == "named" else status)
            ev[f"{rank}_msl41_status"] = msl_status
            msl_counts[(rank, msl_status)] += 1
            vlr, glr = vl.get(rank, ""), gl.get(rank, "")
            if v and g and rank in RANKS[:6]:
                if label_status(vlr) == label_status(glr) == "named":
                    metrics[f"both_tools_named_{rank}"] += 1
                    metrics[f"tools_disagree_named_{rank}"] += vlr != glr
                    if vlr != glr:
                        conflicts.append({"vOTU_id": row["vOTU_id"], "contig_id": cid,
                            "rank": rank, "vitap_label": vlr, "genomad_label": glr,
                            "vitap_confidence": vc, "checkv_quality_tier": QUALITY[row["checkv_quality_score"]],
                            "checkv_completeness": row["checkv_completeness"], "representative_changed": changed})
                if label_status(vlr) != "named" and label_status(glr) == "named":
                    metrics[f"geNomad_named_{rank}_not_used_due_to_VITAP_priority"] += 1
        evidence.append(ev)

    assert metrics["release_rows_disagreeing_with_current_contig_taxonomy"] == 0
    for rank in RANKS:
        assert sum(n for (r, _, _), n in rank_counts.items() if r == rank) == len(release)
    write_tsv(out / "taxonomy-evidence.tsv", evidence)
    write_tsv(out / "rank-status-by-source.tsv", [{"rank": k[0], "label_status": k[1], "source": k[2], "votus": n} for k, n in sorted(rank_counts.items())])
    write_tsv(out / "taxon-counts-by-source.tsv", [{"rank": k[0], "taxon": k[1], "label_status": k[2], "source": k[3], "votus": n} for k, n in sorted(taxon_counts.items())])
    write_tsv(out / "vitap-confidence-by-rank.tsv", [{"rank": k[0], "confidence": k[1], "votus": n} for k, n in sorted(confidence.items())])
    write_tsv(out / "vitap-genomad-named-conflicts.tsv", conflicts)
    write_tsv(out / "family-method-comparison-counts.tsv", [{"catalog_family_scope": k[0], "comparison": k[1], "checkv_quality_tier": k[2], "representative_changed": k[3], "votus": n} for k, n in sorted(comparison_counts.items())])
    write_tsv(out / "family-method-comparison-by-label.tsv", [{"catalog_family": k[0], "comparison": k[1], "votus": n} for k, n in sorted(comparison_families.items())])
    write_tsv(out / "msl41-name-status-counts.tsv", [{"rank": k[0], "msl41_name_status": k[1], "votus": n} for k, n in sorted(msl_counts.items())])

    named_counts = Counter((rank, row[rank]) for row in release for rank in RANKS if label_status(row[rank]) == "named")
    versions = []
    for (rank, name), n in sorted(named_counts.items()):
        now = current.get((rank, name))
        latest = latest_names.get((rank, name), {})
        versions.append({"rank": rank, "catalog_label": name, "votus": n,
            "present_in_MSL41": now is not None, "latest_msl_with_name": latest.get("msl_release_num", ""),
            "ictv_taxnode_id": (now or latest).get("taxnode_id", ""),
            "current_lineage": now.get("lineage", "") if now else "",
            "last_name_out_change": latest.get("out_change", ""),
            "last_name_out_target": latest.get("out_target", ""),
            "last_name_out_filename": latest.get("out_filename", "")})
    write_tsv(out / "catalog-labels-versus-msl41.tsv", versions)
    summary = dict(metrics)
    summary["MSL41_rank_counts"] = dict(official_counts)
    (out / "taxonomy-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
    paths.update({"generator": Path(os.environ["REVISION_QMD"]), "integration_code": root / "analyses/09-taxonomy.qmd", "parser_code": root / "R/utils.R"})
    manifest = []
    for role, path in paths.items():
        with path.open("rb") as handle:
            digest = hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest()
        manifest.append({"role": role, "path": str(path), "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": digest})
    provenance = {"official_taxonomy_source": ICTV_URL, "official_release": "MSL41.v1_20260320",
        "name_status_scope": "Exact name and rank in released metadata; sequence-level taxonomic corroboration remains a separate question.",
        "normalization": "Exact contig identifiers; bracket-prefixed labels are placeholders; blank, NA, NULL and - are missing. In rank counts, named means a nonempty, nonbracketed archived label; species_label_kind separately identifies the two s.vOTU internal operational labels. Archived VITAP confidence labels are preserved.",
        "ictv_scope": "Official tagged MSL41 release, hidden=0 and deleted=0; published rank totals verified. The is_official flag is 0 throughout this export and is not a filter.",
        "quality_score": QUALITY, "inputs": manifest}
    (out / "provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


main(Path(os.environ["REVISION_ROOT"]), Path(os.environ["TAXONOMY_OUT"]))
PYTAXONOMY
```

## Fixed-version catalog comparisons

MegaBLAST outputs use catalog-prefixed identifiers to prevent collisions.
The summaries merge aligned intervals within each query–reference pair and
apply unrounded thresholds. Processing scales with the number of HSPs, with
interval sorting within each pair. Fixed input versions, sequence hashes,
commands, and Slurm resource records are stored with the comparison. Repeating
alignment uses the generated `catalog.sbatch` stages `prepare`, `full`,
`mgv-prepare`, and `mgv-full`; the summary reuses their saved outputs.

```{r}
#| label: catalog-comparison-paths
#| cache: false
Sys.setenv(CATALOG_COMPARISON = path_target("catalog-comparison"))
```

```{bash}
#| label: catalog-comparison-programs
#| cache: false
cat > "$CATALOG_COMPARISON/catalog_compare.py" <<'PYCOMPARE'
"""固定版目录的序列重叠统计；运行入口和结果均位于当前分析步骤。"""
import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
import csv
import gzip
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.request

from Bio import SeqIO

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RELEASE = ROOT.parent / "release"
CATALOGS = {"CVD": (29587145, 56333303), "CMKMC": (24681096, 43380048)}


def save_json(name, value):
    (ROOT / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")


def digest(path, algorithm="sha256"):
    h = hashlib.new(algorithm)
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for data in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(data)
    return h.hexdigest()


def run(args, output=None):
    args = [str(a) for a in args]
    started = time.time()
    with (ROOT / "commands.jsonl").open("a") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps({"command": args, "started_unix": started,
                                 "job_id": os.getenv("SLURM_JOB_ID")}) + "\n")
    if output:
        with output.open("w") as handle:
            subprocess.run(args, check=True, stdout=handle)
    else:
        subprocess.run(args, check=True)
    return time.time() - started


def prepare():
    inputs = {}
    for label, (article, file_id) in CATALOGS.items():
        url = f"https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/{article}/versions/1"
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60) as response:
            metadata = json.load(response)
        save_json(f"{label.lower()}-version1.json", metadata)
        info = next(f for f in metadata["files"] if f["id"] == file_id)
        path = ROOT / f"{label}.source{'.fna.gz' if info['name'].endswith('.gz') else '.fna'}"
        if not path.exists():
            partial = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".part")
            run(["curl", "--fail", "--location", "--retry", "3", "--max-time", "900",
                 "--silent", "--show-error", "--output", partial, info["download_url"]])
            assert partial.stat().st_size == info["size"]
            assert digest(partial, "md5") == info["computed_md5"]
            partial.replace(path)
        assert path.stat().st_size == info["size"]
        assert digest(path, "md5") == info["computed_md5"]
        inputs[label] = {"path": str(path), "version_doi": metadata["doi"],
                         "metadata_url": url, "download_url": info["download_url"],
                         "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "md5": digest(path, "md5"),
                         "sha256": digest(path)}
    query = RELEASE / "vOTUs.fasta.gz"
    expected = json.loads((RELEASE / "manifest.json").read_text())["files"]["vOTUs.fasta.gz"]
    assert digest(query) == expected["sha256"]
    inputs["AVIAN"] = {"path": str(query), "bytes": query.stat().st_size,
                       "sha256": digest(query), "annotation_sha256": digest(RELEASE / "vOTU_annotation.tsv.gz")}
    with gzip.open(RELEASE / "vOTU_annotation.tsv.gz", "rt") as handle:
        annotation = {r["contig_repid"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t")}
    indices, stats = [], {}
    for label, info in inputs.items():
        path = Path(info["path"])
        opener = gzip.open if path.suffix == ".gz" else open
        rows = []
        with opener(path, "rt") as handle, (ROOT / f"{label}.fna").open("w") as output:
            for rec in SeqIO.parse(handle, "fasta"):
                original = rec.id
                rec.id = f"{label}|{original}"
                rec.description = rec.id
                rec.seq = rec.seq.upper()
                SeqIO.write(rec, output, "fasta")
                row = {"catalog": label, "sequence_id": rec.id, "original_id": original,
                       "length": len(rec), "sequence_sha256": hashlib.sha256(bytes(rec.seq)).hexdigest(),
                       "quality": "published_medium_or_better" if label == "CVD" else "published_catalog",
                       "vOTU_id": "", "completeness": ""}
                if label == "AVIAN":
                    a = annotation[original]
                    assert len(rec) == int(a["contig_length"])
                    row.update(quality={"1": "Complete", "2": "High", "3": "Medium", "4": "Low"}[a["checkv_quality_score"]],
                               vOTU_id=a["vOTU_id"], completeness=a["checkv_completeness"])
                rows.append(row)
        assert len(rows) == len({r["sequence_id"] for r in rows})
        if label == "AVIAN":
            assert len(rows) == 61608 == len(annotation)
        stats[label] = {"records": len(rows), "bases": sum(r["length"] for r in rows),
                        "min_length": min(r["length"] for r in rows), "max_length": max(r["length"] for r in rows),
                        "unique_sequence_sha256": len({r["sequence_sha256"] for r in rows})}
        indices.extend(rows)
    with (ROOT / "sequence-index.tsv").open("w") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(indices[0]), delimiter="\t")
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(indices)
    with (ROOT / "references.fna").open("wb") as output:
        for label in CATALOGS:
            with (ROOT / f"{label}.fna").open("rb") as handle:
                for data in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                    output.write(data)
    run(["makeblastdb", "-in", ROOT / "references.fna", "-out", ROOT / "reference_db", "-dbtype", "nucl"])
    selected = sorted((r for r in indices if r["catalog"] == "AVIAN"),
                      key=lambda r: hashlib.sha256(r["sequence_id"].encode()).digest())[:500]
    selected_ids = {r["sequence_id"] for r in selected}
    with (ROOT / "AVIAN.fna").open() as handle, (ROOT / "pilot.fna").open("w") as output:
        SeqIO.write((r for r in SeqIO.parse(handle, "fasta") if r.id in selected_ids), output, "fasta")
    save_json("input-manifest.json", {"inputs": inputs, "sequence_stats": stats,
              "pilot_records": len(selected), "pilot_bases": sum(r["length"] for r in selected),
              "software": {k: importlib.metadata.version(k) for k in ["biopython", "vpipe"]},
              "method": {"ani_min": 95, "shorter_aligned_fraction_min": 85,
                         "ani": "alignment-length-weighted identity of retained BLAST HSPs",
                         "coverage": "union of inclusive alignment intervals divided by each sequence length",
                         "equal_length_rule": "require both coverage values >=85",
                         "quality_scope": "AVIAN all retained representatives; CVD supplied medium+; CMKMC supplied catalog"}})


def prepare_mgv():
    base = "https://portal.nersc.gov/MGV/MGV_v1.0_2021_07_08/"
    inputs = {}
    for name in ["README.txt", "mgv_votu_representatives.fna", "mgv_contig_info.tsv", "mgv_sample_info.tsv"]:
        url, path = base + name, ROOT / name
        with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, method="HEAD"), timeout=60) as response:
            size = int(response.headers["Content-Length"])
            etag, modified = response.headers.get("ETag"), response.headers.get("Last-Modified")
        if not path.exists():
            partial = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".part")
            run(["curl", "--fail", "--location", "--retry", "3", "--max-time", "1800",
                 "--silent", "--show-error", "--output", partial, url])
            assert partial.stat().st_size == size
            partial.replace(path)
        assert path.stat().st_size == size
        inputs[name] = {"url": url, "path": str(path), "bytes": size, "etag": etag,
                        "last_modified": modified, "sha256": digest(path), "checksum_scope": "local_sha256"}
    with (ROOT / "mgv_contig_info.tsv").open() as handle:
        metadata = {r["contig_id"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t")}
    rows = []
    with (ROOT / "mgv_votu_representatives.fna").open() as handle, (ROOT / "MGV.fna").open("w") as output:
        for rec in SeqIO.parse(handle, "fasta"):
            original = rec.id
            a = metadata[original]
            rec.id, rec.description = f"MGV|{original}", f"MGV|{original}"
            rec.seq = rec.seq.upper()
            SeqIO.write(rec, output, "fasta")
            rows.append({"catalog": "MGV", "sequence_id": rec.id, "original_id": original,
                         "length": len(rec), "sequence_sha256": hashlib.sha256(bytes(rec.seq)).hexdigest(),
                         "quality": a["checkv_quality"], "vOTU_id": a["votu_id"], "completeness": a["completeness"],
                         "metadata_length": int(a["length"]), "length_matches_metadata": len(rec)==int(a["length"]),
                         "metadata_prophage": a["prophage"]})
    assert len(rows) == 54118 == len({r["sequence_id"] for r in rows}) == len({r["vOTU_id"] for r in rows})
    with (ROOT / "mgv-sequence-index.tsv").open("w") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(rows[0]), delimiter="\t")
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)
    stats = {"records": len(rows), "bases": sum(r["length"] for r in rows),
             "min_length": min(r["length"] for r in rows), "max_length": max(r["length"] for r in rows),
             "unique_sequence_sha256": len({r["sequence_sha256"] for r in rows}),
             "metadata_length_mismatch": sum(not r["length_matches_metadata"] for r in rows)}
    save_json("mgv-input-manifest.json", {"version": "MGV_v1.0_2021_07_08", "inputs": inputs,
              "sequence_stats": stats, "quality_scope": "published medium, high, complete representatives"})
    run(["makeblastdb", "-in", ROOT / "MGV.fna", "-out", ROOT / "mgv_db", "-dbtype", "nucl"])


def align(mode):
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / "input-manifest.json").read_text())
    nrefs = sum(manifest["sequence_stats"][c]["records"] for c in CATALOGS)
    database = ROOT / "reference_db"
    if mode.startswith("mgv-"):
        nrefs = json.loads((ROOT / "mgv-input-manifest.json").read_text())["sequence_stats"]["records"]
        database = ROOT / "mgv_db"
    query = ROOT / ("pilot.fna" if mode.endswith("pilot") else "AVIAN.fna")
    output = ROOT / f"{mode}.blast.tsv"
    command = ["blastn", "-task", "megablast", "-query", query, "-db", database,
               "-out", output, "-outfmt", "6 std qlen slen", "-max_target_seqs", nrefs,
               "-perc_identity", "90", "-evalue", "0.001", "-dust", "no",
               "-num_threads", os.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", "8")]
    elapsed = run(command)
    save_json(f"{mode}-timing.json", {"elapsed_seconds": elapsed, "command": [str(s) for s in command],
              "blast_sha256": digest(output), "bytes": output.stat().st_size,
              "job_id": os.getenv("SLURM_JOB_ID"), "node": os.uname().nodename})
    run(["vpipe", "mgv", "ani", "--blast", output, "--output", ROOT / f"{mode}.ani.tsv"])


def refine_identity(mode):
    with (ROOT / f"{mode}-identity-boundary.tsv").open() as handle:
        boundary = list(csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t"))
    selected = {r["query_id"] for r in boundary}
    query = ROOT / f"{mode}-boundary.fna"
    with (ROOT / "AVIAN.fna").open() as handle, query.open("w") as output:
        SeqIO.write((r for r in SeqIO.parse(handle,"fasta") if r.id in selected),output,"fasta")
    is_mgv = mode.startswith("mgv-")
    database = ROOT / ("mgv_db" if is_mgv else "reference_db")
    nrefs = 54118 if is_mgv else 50679
    blast = ROOT / f"{mode}-boundary.blast.tsv"
    run(["blastn","-task","megablast","-query",query,"-db",database,"-out",blast,
         "-outfmt","6 qseqid sseqid pident length mismatch gapopen qstart qend sstart send nident evalue bitscore qlen slen",
         "-max_target_seqs",nrefs,"-perc_identity","90","-evalue","0.001","-dust","no",
         "-num_threads",os.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK","8")])
    totals = defaultdict(lambda: [0,0,0])
    with blast.open() as handle:
        for fields in csv.reader(handle,delimiter="\t"):
            value = totals[(fields[0],fields[1])]
            value[0] += int(fields[10])
            value[1] += int(fields[3])
            value[2] += 1
    with (ROOT / f"{mode}-identity-exact.tsv").open("w") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle,fieldnames=["query_id","reference_id","ani_percent","nident_sum","alignment_length_sum","hsp_count"],delimiter="\t")
        writer.writeheader()
        for row in boundary:
            identities,length,hsps = totals[(row["query_id"],row["reference_id"])]
            assert hsps == int(row["hsp_count"])
            exact = 100*identities/length
            assert abs(exact-float(row["ani_percent"])) <= 0.00051
            writer.writerow({"query_id":row["query_id"],"reference_id":row["reference_id"],"ani_percent":exact,
                             "nident_sum":identities,"alignment_length_sum":length,"hsp_count":hsps})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("stage", choices=["prepare", "pilot", "full", "mgv-prepare", "mgv-pilot", "mgv-full", "full-boundary", "mgv-full-boundary"])
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, default=ROOT)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    ROOT = args.output_dir.resolve()
    RELEASE = ROOT.parent / "release"
    if args.stage == "prepare":
        prepare()
    elif args.stage == "mgv-prepare":
        prepare_mgv()
    elif args.stage.endswith("-boundary"):
        refine_identity(args.stage.removesuffix("-boundary"))
    else:
        align(args.stage)

cat > "$CATALOG_COMPARISON/catalog_summary.py" <<'PYSUMMARY'
"""按短序列覆盖率汇总固定版本目录的序列匹配。"""
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import argparse
import csv
import gzip
import json
from pathlib import Path

from vpipe.core.mgv import _yield_alignment_blocks

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def read_tsv(path):
    with path.open() as handle:
        return list(csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t"))


def write_tsv(name, rows):
    if not rows:
        return
    with (ROOT / name).open("w") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(rows[0]), delimiter="\t")
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def union_length(intervals):
    intervals = sorted(intervals)
    start, stop = intervals[0]
    total = 0
    for a, b in intervals[1:]:
        if a <= stop + 1:
            stop = max(stop, b)
        else:
            total += stop - start + 1
            start, stop = a, b
    return total + stop - start + 1


def pairs(mode, index):
    passed, boundary, stats = [], [], Counter()
    exact_path = ROOT / f"{mode}-identity-exact.tsv"
    exact = {(r["query_id"],r["reference_id"]):r for r in read_tsv(exact_path)} if exact_path.exists() else {}
    best, seen = {}, set()
    with (ROOT / f"{mode}.blast.tsv").open() as handle:
        for blocks in _yield_alignment_blocks(handle):
            blocks = [a for a in blocks if a["evalue"] <= 0.001]
            if not blocks:
                continue
            first = blocks[0]
            q, t = first["qname"], first["tname"]
            assert (q, t) not in seen
            seen.add((q, t))
            qlen, tlen = int(first["qlen"]), int(first["tlen"])
            assert qlen == int(index[q]["length"]) and tlen == int(index[t]["length"])
            ani = sum(a["len"] * a["pid"] for a in blocks) / sum(a["len"] for a in blocks)
            reported_ani = ani
            if (q,t) in exact:
                assert len(blocks)==int(exact[(q,t)]["hsp_count"])
                assert sum(a["len"] for a in blocks)==int(exact[(q,t)]["alignment_length_sum"])
                ani = float(exact[(q,t)]["ani_percent"])
                stats["pairs_refined_using_integer_nident"] += 1
            qaf = 100 * union_length([a["qcoords"] for a in blocks]) / qlen
            taf = 100 * union_length([a["tcoords"] for a in blocks]) / tlen
            assert 0 <= qaf <= 100 and 0 <= taf <= 100
            direction = "query" if qlen < tlen else "reference" if tlen < qlen else "equal"
            saf = qaf if qlen < tlen else taf if tlen < qlen else min(qaf, taf)
            rounded_pass = round(ani, 2) >= 95 and round(saf, 2) >= 85
            exact_pass = ani >= 95 and saf >= 85
            stats["pairs_with_hsps"] += 1
            stats["threshold_decision_changed_by_rounding"] += rounded_pass != exact_pass
            row = {"query_id": q, "vOTU_id": index[q]["vOTU_id"], "reference_id": t,
                   "reference_catalog": index[t]["catalog"], "query_length": qlen,
                   "reference_length": tlen, "ani_percent": ani, "query_af_percent": qaf,
                   "reference_af_percent": taf, "shorter_direction": direction,
                   "shorter_af_percent": saf, "hsp_count": len(blocks),
                   "query_quality": index[q]["quality"],
                   "reference_quality_scope": "as-supplied catalog" if index[t]["catalog"] == "MGV" else index[t]["quality"],
                   "reference_metadata_length_matches": index[t].get("length_matches_metadata", "unavailable"),
                   "both_af_ge_85": qaf >= 85 and taf >= 85, "matched": exact_pass}
            if abs(reported_ani-95) <= 0.0005 and saf >= 85:
                boundary.append(row)
            key = (q, index[t]["catalog"])
            score = (exact_pass, ani, saf)
            if key not in best or score > best[key][0]:
                best[key] = score, row
            if exact_pass:
                passed.append(row)
                stats[f"matched_shorter_{direction}"] += 1
    write_tsv(f"{mode}-matched-pairs.tsv", passed)
    write_tsv(f"{mode}-identity-boundary.tsv", boundary)
    stats["pairs_within_blast_identity_precision_of_threshold"] = len(boundary)
    write_tsv(f"{mode}-best-pairs.tsv", [value[1] for value in best.values()])
    return passed, dict(stats)


def main(modes):
    rows = read_tsv(ROOT / "sequence-index.tsv")
    if any(m.startswith("mgv-") for m in modes):
        rows += read_tsv(ROOT / "mgv-sequence-index.tsv")
    index = {r["sequence_id"]: r for r in rows}
    query = {r["sequence_id"]: r for r in rows if r["catalog"] == "AVIAN"}
    all_matches, checks = [], {}
    for mode in modes:
        matches, check = pairs(mode, index)
        all_matches += matches
        checks[mode] = check
    catalogs = (["CVD", "CMKMC"] if "full" in modes else []) + (["MGV"] if "mgv-full" in modes else [])
    query_matches = {c: set() for c in catalogs}
    reference_matches = {c: set() for c in catalogs}
    bilateral = {c: set() for c in catalogs}
    for m in all_matches:
        c = m["reference_catalog"]
        query_matches[c].add(m["query_id"])
        reference_matches[c].add(m["reference_id"])
        if m["both_af_ge_85"]:
            bilateral[c].add(m["query_id"])
    union = set().union(*query_matches.values())
    query_matches["Any compared catalog"] = union
    summaries = []
    subsets = {"All": set(query), "Complete+High": {q for q,a in query.items() if a["quality"] in ["Complete","High"]},
               "Complete+High+Medium": {q for q,a in query.items() if a["quality"] in ["Complete","High","Medium"]}}
    for quality in ["Complete", "High", "Medium", "Low"]:
        subsets[quality] = {q for q,a in query.items() if a["quality"] == quality}
    with gzip.open(ROOT.parent / "release/vOTU_annotation.tsv.gz", "rt") as handle:
        contamination = {"AVIAN|"+r["contig_repid"]:float(r["checkv_contamination"])
                         for r in csv.DictReader(handle,delimiter="\t")}
    subsets["Completeness>90%; contamination<=5%"] = {q for q in query
                                                       if contamination[q]<=5 and float(query[q]["completeness"])>90}
    for label, test in [("length<5000", lambda n:n<5000), ("5000<=length<10000",lambda n:5000<=n<10000),
                        ("length>=10000", lambda n:n>=10000)]:
        subsets[label] = {q for q,a in query.items() if test(int(a["length"]))}
    for c, matched in query_matches.items():
        for label, subset in subsets.items():
            n = len(matched & subset)
            summaries.append({"reference_catalog": c, "query_stratum": label,
                              "query_denominator": len(subset), "matched_queries": n,
                              "unmatched_queries": len(subset)-n,
                              "matched_percent": 100*n/len(subset) if subset else None})
    write_tsv("query-overlap-summary.tsv", summaries)
    ref_summary = []
    for c in catalogs:
        ref = {r["sequence_id"]:r for r in rows if r["catalog"]==c}
        for quality in ["All"]:
            subset = {k for k,v in ref.items() if quality=="All" or v["quality"]==quality}
            n = len(reference_matches[c] & subset)
            ref_summary.append({"reference_catalog":c,"reference_stratum":quality,"reference_denominator":len(subset),
                                "matched_references":n,"matched_percent":100*n/len(subset)})
    write_tsv("reference-overlap-summary.tsv",ref_summary)
    flags = []
    for q, row in query.items():
        flags.append({"query_id":q,"vOTU_id":row["vOTU_id"],"length":row["length"],"quality":row["quality"],
                      **{f"matched_{c}":q in query_matches[c] for c in catalogs},"matched_any":q in union})
    write_tsv("query-match-flags.tsv", flags)
    sensitivity = []
    if "MGV" in catalogs:
        mgv_concordant = {m["query_id"] for m in all_matches if m["reference_catalog"]=="MGV"
                          and m["reference_metadata_length_matches"]=="True"}
        filtered_union = mgv_concordant | query_matches.get("CVD",set()) | query_matches.get("CMKMC",set())
        for label, matched in [("MGV: metadata-length-concordant references",mgv_concordant),
                               ("Any catalog: MGV metadata-length-concordant references",filtered_union)]:
            for stratum, subset in subsets.items():
                n = len(matched & subset)
                sensitivity.append({"reference_scope":label,"query_stratum":stratum,
                                    "query_denominator":len(subset),"matched_queries":n,
                                    "unmatched_queries":len(subset)-n,
                                    "matched_percent":100*n/len(subset) if subset else None})
        write_tsv("metadata-length-sensitivity.tsv",sensitivity)
    summary = {"query_denominator":len(query),"compared_catalogs":catalogs,"matched_any":len(union),
               "unmatched_within_compared_scope":len(query)-len(union),"per_catalog":{c:{"matched_queries":len(query_matches[c]),
               "matched_references":len(reference_matches[c]),"queries_both_af_ge_85":len(bilateral[c])} for c in catalogs},
               "checks":checks,"metadata_length_sensitivity":sensitivity,
               "scope":"固定版参考目录的序列覆盖；质量分层使用已核对Avian代表的CheckV标签；未匹配范围限于列出的参考版本。"}
    (ROOT / "overlap-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("modes",nargs="*",choices=["full","mgv-full"],default=["full"])
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir",type=Path,default=ROOT)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    ROOT = args.output_dir.resolve()
    main(args.modes)

PYSUMMARY
```

## Limited exemplar corroboration

This quality-selected analysis describes sequence relationships for 554
family-labeled Caudoviricetes. Candidate retrieval and numerical intervals do
not assign formal taxa. The raw directional alignments remain in this step.
Heavy stages run through the generated Slurm entry; rendering only summarizes
completed comparisons and exports Table S12.

```{r}

#| cache: false
Sys.setenv(TAXONOMY_COMPARE = path_target("catalog-comparison", "taxonomy"))
```

```{bash}
#| label: taxonomy-corroboration-programs
#| cache: false
mkdir -p "$TAXONOMY_COMPARE"
cat > "$TAXONOMY_COMPARE/taxonomy_compare.py" <<'TAXCODE0'
"""固定参考的 tailed dsDNA phage 分类相似度佐证。"""
import argparse
import csv
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.request
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

from Bio import SeqIO
import openpyxl

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PINNED = {
    'Bacteriophage_genomes.fasta.gz': 'bf39b1aac97baae3a970287aaa6185821fbc91c085ee639f2d7c0743381f6656',
    'ICTV.msh': 'bd3bb08a2b3dc1117c1f0a8387032a1661bd9d967d4a194fc91533408826fd7c',
    'M.pa': '11b424f08df30303f6333d876bc0d3c32489434c821088d27bb24077781c30a4',
    'VMR.xlsx': '9d51698034d0bf54648de94b3ff6bf99fc1d9d2b116681991f6284901dd8b4a2',
}


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for b in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()


def save(name, obj):
    (ROOT / name).write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str) + '\n')


def run(command, log):
    start = time.time()
    with (ROOT / log).open('w') as handle:
        subprocess.run([str(x) for x in command], check=True, stdout=handle, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    entry = {'command': [str(x) for x in command], 'elapsed_seconds': time.time()-start,
             'job_id': os.getenv('SLURM_JOB_ID'), 'node': os.uname().nodename}
    with (ROOT / 'commands.jsonl').open('a') as h:
        h.write(json.dumps(entry) + '\n')
    return entry


def write_tsv(name, rows):
    with (ROOT / name).open('w') as h:
        w = csv.DictWriter(h, fieldnames=list(rows[0]), delimiter='\t')
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)


def vmr_rows(path):
    w = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    s = next(w[x] for x in w.sheetnames if 'VMR' in x)
    it = s.iter_rows(values_only=True)
    fields = next(it)
    rows = [dict(zip(fields, row)) for row in it]
    return [row for row in rows if row.get('Isolate ID')]


def current_vmr():
    name='VMR_MSL41.v1.20260729.xlsx'
    url='https://ictv.global/sites/default/files/VMR/'+name
    path=ROOT/name
    expected='b79b5d82a1b3b8e9dd5e19afe8fe1a8f441267474918a7cefa8ae4913adf45bb'
    if not path.exists():
        temporary=path.with_suffix('.part')
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=90) as source,temporary.open('wb') as target:
            shutil.copyfileobj(source,target)
        assert sha(temporary)==expected
        temporary.replace(path)
    assert sha(path)==expected
    earlier={r['Isolate ID']:r for r in vmr_rows(ROOT/'database/VMR.xlsx') if r['Class']=='Caudoviricetes'}
    current={r['Isolate ID']:r for r in vmr_rows(path) if r['Class']=='Caudoviricetes'}
    fields=['Class','Order','Family','Subfamily','Genus','Species','Virus GENBANK accession','Genome coverage','Genome','Host source']
    differences=[{'isolate':k,'changed_fields':[c for c in fields if earlier[k].get(c)!=current[k].get(c)]}
                 for k in sorted(earlier.keys()&current.keys()) if any(earlier[k].get(c)!=current[k].get(c) for c in fields)]
    save('vmr-version-comparison.json',{'official_current_url':url,'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':expected,
         'bundled_vmr_version':'MSL41.v1 2026-03-20','official_current_version':'MSL41.v1 2026-07-29',
         'compared_class':'Caudoviricetes','bundled_isolates':len(earlier),'current_isolates':len(current),
         'added_ids':sorted(current.keys()-earlier.keys()),'removed_ids':sorted(earlier.keys()-current.keys()),
         'classification_accession_coverage_genome_host_field_differences':differences})


def prepare():
    db = ROOT / 'database'
    db.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    downloads = []
    cached_manifest = json.loads((ROOT/'input-manifest.json').read_text()) if (ROOT/'input-manifest.json').exists() else {}
    cached_downloads = {Path(r['path']).name:r for r in cached_manifest.get('downloads',[])}
    for name in ['Bacteriophage_genomes.fasta.gz', 'ICTV.msh', 'M.pa', 'VMR.xlsx']:
        url = 'https://millardlab-taxmyphage.s3.climb.ac.uk/current/' + name
        path = db / name
        if path.exists():
            assert sha(path)==PINNED[name], 'Local reference differs from pinned snapshot.'
            length=path.stat().st_size
            headers=cached_downloads.get(name,{}).get('http_headers',{})
        else:
            request = urllib.request.Request(url, method='HEAD')
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=90) as response:
                headers = dict(response.headers)
            length = int(headers.get('Content-Length', headers.get('content-length')))
            with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=90) as stream, path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.part').open('wb') as output:
                shutil.copyfileobj(stream, output)
            assert sha(path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.part'))==PINNED[name], 'Remote current snapshot changed.'
            path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.part').replace(path)
        assert path.stat().st_size == length
        assert sha(path) == PINNED[name], 'Remote current snapshot changed; retain the pinned local reference release.'
        downloads.append({'url': url, 'path': str(path), 'bytes': length,
                          'sha256': sha(path), 'http_headers': headers})
    current_vmr()
    fasta = db / 'Bacteriophage_genomes.fasta'
    with gzip.open(db / 'Bacteriophage_genomes.fasta.gz', 'rb') as src, fasta.open('wb') as dst:
        shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
    run(['makeblastdb','-in',fasta,'-parse_seqids','-dbtype','nucl'], 'makeblastdb.log')
    refs = []
    with fasta.open() as h:
        for record in SeqIO.parse(h, 'fasta'):
            refs.append({'accession':record.id,'length':len(record),'description':record.description})
    write_tsv('reference-index.tsv', refs)
    assert len({r['accession'] for r in refs}) == len(refs)
    vmr = vmr_rows(db / 'VMR.xlsx')
    norm = lambda a: str(a or '').split('.')[0]
    refs_ids = {norm(r['accession']) for r in refs}
    joined = [r for r in vmr if norm(r['Virus GENBANK accession']) in refs_ids]
    vmr_fields = ['Isolate ID','Class','Order','Family','Genus','Species','Exemplar or additional isolate','Virus GENBANK accession','Genome coverage','Genome','Host source']
    write_tsv('reference-vmr.tsv',[{k:r.get(k) for k in vmr_fields} for r in joined])
    evidence = ROOT.parent.parent / 'remaining-evidence/taxonomy/taxonomy-evidence.tsv'
    with evidence.open() as h:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(h, delimiter='\t'))
    selected = [r for r in rows if r['class']=='Caudoviricetes' and r['family'] and not r['family'].startswith('[')
                and float(r['checkv_completeness']) > 90 and float(r['checkv_contamination']) <= 5]
    write_tsv('query-evidence.tsv', selected)
    ids = {r['current_representative_id'] for r in selected}
    selected_records = []
    with gzip.open(ROOT.parent.parent / 'release/vOTUs.fasta.gz','rt') as h:
        for record in SeqIO.parse(h,'fasta'):
            if record.id in ids:
                selected_records.append(record)
    assert len(selected_records)==len(ids)==len(selected)
    SeqIO.write(selected_records, ROOT / 'queries.fna','fasta')
    # 固定ID哈希排序选取各命名family一条，兼顾不同目录标签。
    pilot_ids = set()
    for family in sorted({r['family'] for r in selected}):
        group = [r for r in selected if r['family']==family]
        pilot_ids.add(min(group,key=lambda r:hashlib.sha256(r['vOTU_id'].encode()).hexdigest())['current_representative_id'])
    SeqIO.write([r for r in selected_records if r.id in pilot_ids],ROOT / 'pilot.fna','fasta')
    SeqIO.write([r for r in selected_records if r.id not in pilot_ids],ROOT / 'remaining.fna','fasta')
    save('input-manifest.json',{'downloads':downloads,'database_release':'taxMyPhage current snapshot 2026-04-06; bundled VMR MSL41.v1 2026-03-20',
         'reference_records':len(refs),'reference_total_bases':sum(r['length'] for r in refs),
         'reference_vmr_rows':len(joined),'reference_class_counts':dict(Counter(r['Class'] for r in joined)),
         'reference_host_source_counts':dict(Counter(r['Host source'] for r in joined)),
         'reference_genome_coverage_counts':dict(Counter(r['Genome coverage'] for r in joined)),
         'reference_exemplar_isolate_counts':dict(Counter(r['Exemplar or additional isolate'] for r in joined)),
         'reference_accessions_without_bundled_vmr_match':sorted(refs_ids-{norm(r['Virus GENBANK accession']) for r in joined}),
         'archaeal_references_in_database':sum(r['Host source']=='archaea' for r in joined),
         'query_count':len(selected),'query_total_bases':sum(len(r) for r in selected_records),
         'query_quality_counts':dict(Counter(r['checkv_quality_tier'] for r in selected)),
         'query_family_counts':dict(Counter(r['family'] for r in selected)),
         'selection':'named Caudoviricetes; completeness >90%; contamination <=5%; current representative',
         'pilot_queries':len(pilot_ids),'pilot_ids':sorted(pilot_ids),
         'input_evidence_sha256':sha(evidence),'query_fasta_sha256':sha(ROOT/'queries.fna'),
         'taxmyphage_version':'0.3.7','source_sha256':sha(Path(__file__))})


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('stage',choices=['prepare'])
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path,default=ROOT)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    ROOT=args.output_dir.resolve()
    ROOT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    prepare()

"""taxMyPhage 候选召回后，仅计算查询与参考的真实双向 similarity。"""
import argparse
import csv
import gzip
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from Bio import SeqIO
import taxonomy_compare as common

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUTFMT = '6 qseqid sseqid pident length qlen slen mismatch nident gapopen qstart qend sstart send qseq sseq evalue bitscore'
BLAST = ['blastn','-evalue','1','-max_target_seqs','10000','-num_threads','1',
         '-word_size','7','-reward','2','-penalty','-3','-gapopen','5','-gapextend','2']


def read_tsv(path):
    with path.open() as h:
        return list(csv.DictReader(h,delimiter='\t'))


def candidates():
    common.run(['mash','sketch','-i','-k','21','-s','5000','-p','8','-o',ROOT/'queries',ROOT/'queries.fna'],'mash-sketch.log')
    common.run(['mash','dist','-d','0.2','-p','8',ROOT/'database/ICTV.msh',ROOT/'queries.msh'],'mash-dist.tsv')
    vmr = common.vmr_rows(ROOT/'database/VMR.xlsx')
    norm = lambda x:str(x or '').split('.')[0]
    genome_ids = {r['accession'] for r in read_tsv(ROOT/'reference-index.tsv')}
    taxa = {norm(r['Virus GENBANK accession']):r for r in vmr if norm(r['Virus GENBANK accession']) in genome_ids}
    by_query = defaultdict(list)
    with (ROOT/'mash-dist.tsv').open() as h:
        for r in csv.reader(h,delimiter='\t'):
            acc = Path(r[0]).name.split('.')[0]
            by_query[r[1]].append({'accession':acc,'distance':float(r[2]),'p_value':float(r[3]),'shared_hashes':r[4]})
    output = {}
    for q in read_tsv(ROOT/'query-evidence.tsv'):
        qid = q['current_representative_id']
        hits = sorted(by_query[qid],key=lambda r:(r['distance'],r['accession']))
        genera = {taxa[r['accession']]['Genus'] for r in hits[:10] if r['accession'] in taxa and taxa[r['accession']]['Genus']}
        refs = sorted(r for r,a in taxa.items() if a['Genus'] in genera)
        output[qid] = {'mash_hits':len(hits),'top10':hits[:10],'genera':sorted(genera),'candidate_accessions':refs}
    common.save('candidates.json',output)


def execute(command, log, commands):
    start=time.time()
    with log.open('w') as h:
        subprocess.run([str(x) for x in command],check=True,stdout=h,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    commands.append({'command':[str(x) for x in command],'elapsed_seconds':time.time()-start})


def directional_counts(path):
    identity,coverage,sizes = {},{},{}
    with path.open() as h:
        for r in csv.reader(h,delimiter='\t'):
            assert len(r)==17
            q,t=r[:2]
            qlen,tlen=int(r[4]),int(r[5]);a,b=int(r[9]),int(r[10])
            assert 1<=a<=b<=qlen
            sizes[q]=qlen;sizes[t]=tlen
            key=q,t
            identity.setdefault(key,np.zeros(qlen,dtype=np.bool_))
            coverage.setdefault(key,np.zeros(qlen,dtype=np.bool_))
            qs=np.frombuffer(r[13].encode(),dtype='S1');ts=np.frombuffer(r[14].encode(),dtype='S1')
            equal=(qs==ts)[qs!=b'-']
            assert len(equal)==b-a+1
            identity[key][a-1:b] |= equal
            coverage[key][a-1:b] = True
    return {k:int(x.sum()) for k,x in identity.items()},{k:int(x.sum()) for k,x in coverage.items()},sizes


def one_query(qid, candidate, query, references):
    p=ROOT/'direct'/qid
    if (p/'complete.json').exists():
        return json.loads((p/'complete.json').read_text())
    p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    start=time.time();commands=[];pairs=[]
    if candidate['candidate_accessions']:
        q=p/'query.fna';r=p/'references.fna'
        SeqIO.write([query],q,'fasta')
        selected=[references[a] for a in candidate['candidate_accessions']]
        SeqIO.write(selected,r,'fasta')
        for fasta in [q,r]:
            execute(['makeblastdb','-in',fasta,'-out',str(fasta)+'.db','-dbtype','nucl'],p/(fasta.stem+'-db.log'),commands)
        forward=p/'query-to-reference.tsv';reverse=p/'reference-to-query.tsv'
        for a,b,out in [(q,r,forward),(r,q,reverse)]:
            execute(BLAST+['-query',a,'-db',str(b)+'.db','-out',out,'-outfmt',OUTFMT],p/(out.stem+'.log'),commands)
        ia,ca,sa=directional_counts(forward);ib,cb,sb=directional_counts(reverse)
        for reference in selected:
            rid=reference.id;qlen=len(query);rlen=len(reference)
            qab=ia.get((qid,rid),0);rba=ib.get((rid,qid),0)
            sim=100*(qab+rba)/(qlen+rlen)
            assert 0<=sim<=100
            pairs.append({'query_id':qid,'reference_accession':rid,'query_length':qlen,'reference_length':rlen,
                          'identical_bases_query_to_reference':qab,'identical_bases_reference_to_query':rba,
                          'reciprocal_similarity_percent':sim,'query_identity_fraction_percent':100*qab/qlen,
                          'reference_identity_fraction_percent':100*rba/rlen,
                          'query_aligned_fraction_percent':100*ca.get((qid,rid),0)/qlen,
                          'reference_aligned_fraction_percent':100*cb.get((rid,qid),0)/rlen,
                          'length_ratio':min(qlen,rlen)/max(qlen,rlen)})
        with (p/'pairs.tsv').open('w') as h:
            w=csv.DictWriter(h,fieldnames=list(pairs[0]),delimiter='\t');w.writeheader();w.writerows(pairs)
        for file in [forward,reverse]:
            with file.open('rb') as src,gzip.open(str(file)+'.gz','wb') as dst:
                import shutil
                shutil.copyfileobj(src,dst)
            file.unlink()
    result={'query_id':qid,'mash_hits':candidate['mash_hits'],'candidate_references':len(candidate['candidate_accessions']),
            'compared_pairs':len(pairs),'elapsed_seconds':time.time()-start,'commands':commands,'job_id':os.getenv('SLURM_JOB_ID')}
    (p/'complete.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    return result


def align(stage):
    candidate=json.loads((ROOT/'candidates.json').read_text())
    queries=SeqIO.to_dict(SeqIO.parse(ROOT/'queries.fna','fasta'))
    references=SeqIO.to_dict(SeqIO.parse(ROOT/'database/Bacteriophage_genomes.fasta','fasta'))
    manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'input-manifest.json').read_text())
    ids=manifest['pilot_ids'] if stage=='pilot-direct' else [q for q in queries if q not in manifest['pilot_ids']]
    start=time.time()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=int(os.getenv('SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK','8'))) as pool:
        results=list(pool.map(lambda q:one_query(q,candidate[q],queries[q],references),ids))
    common.save(stage+'-timing.json',{'query_count':len(ids),'elapsed_seconds':time.time()-start,'job_id':os.getenv('SLURM_JOB_ID'),
                'node':os.uname().nodename,'individual_query_seconds':{r['query_id']:r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in results},
                'candidate_pair_count':sum(r['compared_pairs'] for r in results)})


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('stage',choices=['candidates','pilot-direct','remaining-direct'])
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path,default=ROOT)
    args=parser.parse_args();ROOT=args.output_dir.resolve();common.ROOT=ROOT
    candidates() if args.stage=='candidates' else align(args.stage)

"""近完整命名 Caudoviricetes 与固定 ICTV 参考的逐条相似度佐证。"""
import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import taxonomy_compare as common

SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = SOURCE


def read_tsv(path):
    with path.open() as h:
        return list(csv.DictReader(h, delimiter='\t'))


def similarity_bin(value):
    if value is None:
        return 'no_eligible_reference_candidate'
    if value > 95:
        return '>95'
    if value >= 70:
        return '70_to_95'
    if value >= 60:
        return '60_to_<70'
    return '<60'


def family_relation(query, reference):
    if not reference.get('Family'):
        return 'reference_family_unassigned'
    if query['family']=='Autographiviridae':
        return 'historical_family_current_order_compatible' if reference.get('Order')=='Autographivirales' else 'historical_family_current_order_discordant'
    return 'same_current_family_label' if query['family']==reference['Family'] else 'different_current_family_label'


def main():
    manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'input-manifest.json').read_text())
    query=read_tsv(ROOT/'query-evidence.tsv')
    bundled=common.vmr_rows(ROOT/'database/VMR.xlsx')
    current=common.vmr_rows(ROOT/'VMR_MSL41.v1.20260729.xlsx')
    current_by_id={r['Isolate ID']:r for r in current}
    norm=lambda a:str(a or '').split('.')[0]
    current_by_accession={norm(r['Virus GENBANK accession']):r for r in current}
    reference_ids={r['accession'] for r in read_tsv(ROOT/'reference-index.tsv')}
    bundled_by_accession={norm(r['Virus GENBANK accession']):r for r in bundled}
    refs={a:current_by_id[r['Isolate ID']] for a,r in bundled_by_accession.items() if a in reference_ids and r['Isolate ID'] in current_by_id}
    eligible={a for a,r in refs.items() if r['Class']=='Caudoviricetes' and r['Host source']=='bacteria' and r['Genome']=='dsDNA'
              and r['Genome coverage']=='Complete genome' and r['Exemplar or additional isolate']=='E'
              and a==norm(r['Virus GENBANK accession'])}
    reference_eligibility=[]
    for accession in sorted(reference_ids):
        row=refs.get(accession,{})
        reference_eligibility.append({'fasta_accession':accession,'current_complete_exemplar_eligible':accession in eligible,
             'isolate_id':row.get('Isolate ID',''),'current_accession':row.get('Virus GENBANK accession',''),
             'class':row.get('Class',''),'order':row.get('Order',''),'family':row.get('Family',''),
             'genus':row.get('Genus',''),'species':row.get('Species',''),
             'genome_coverage':row.get('Genome coverage',''),'genome':row.get('Genome',''),
             'host_source':row.get('Host source',''),'exemplar_or_additional':row.get('Exemplar or additional isolate','')})
    common.write_tsv('reference-eligibility.tsv',reference_eligibility)
    query_summary=[];all_pairs=[];total_elapsed=0
    for q in query:
        qid=q['current_representative_id'];p=ROOT/'direct'/qid
        completion=json.loads((p/'complete.json').read_text())
        assert completion['query_id']==qid
        total_elapsed+=completion['elapsed_seconds']
        pairs=read_tsv(p/'pairs.tsv') if (p/'pairs.tsv').exists() else []
        assert len(pairs)==completion['compared_pairs']
        for r in pairs:
            assert r['query_id']==qid
            acc=r['reference_accession'];vmr=refs.get(acc,{})
            r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']=float(r['reciprocal_similarity_percent'])
            assert 0<=r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']<=100
            for side in ['query','reference']:
                assert 0<=float(r[f'{side}_identity_fraction_percent'])<=float(r[f'{side}_aligned_fraction_percent'])<=100
            r.update({'vOTU_id':q['vOTU_id'],'catalog_family':q['family'],'catalog_genus':q['genus'],
                      'query_quality':q['checkv_quality_tier'],'eligible_current_complete_exemplar':acc in eligible,
                      'reference_isolate_id':vmr.get('Isolate ID',''),
                      'reference_current_accession':vmr.get('Virus GENBANK accession',''),
                      'reference_genome_coverage':vmr.get('Genome coverage',''),
                      'reference_isolate_status':vmr.get('Exemplar or additional isolate',''),
                      'reference_class':vmr.get('Class',''),'reference_order':vmr.get('Order',''),
                      'reference_family':vmr.get('Family',''),'reference_genus':vmr.get('Genus',''),
                      'reference_species':vmr.get('Species',''),'family_relation':family_relation(q,vmr)})
        all_pairs.extend(pairs)
        ep=[r for r in pairs if r['eligible_current_complete_exemplar']]
        best=max(ep,key=lambda r:r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']) if ep else None
        val=best['reciprocal_similarity_percent'] if best else None
        same=[r for r in ep if r['family_relation'] in ['same_current_family_label','historical_family_current_order_compatible']]
        same_best=max((r['reciprocal_similarity_percent'] for r in same),default=None)
        genus_named=bool(q['genus']) and not q['genus'].startswith('[')
        qsummary={'vOTU_id':q['vOTU_id'],'query_id':qid,'quality':q['checkv_quality_tier'],
                  'completeness':q['checkv_completeness'],'contamination':q['checkv_contamination'],
                  'catalog_family':q['family'],'catalog_family_msl41_status':q['family_msl41_status'],
                  'catalog_genus':q['genus'],'catalog_genus_msl41_status':q['genus_msl41_status'],
                  'mash_hit_count':completion['mash_hits'],'compared_references':len(pairs),'eligible_complete_exemplars':len(ep),
                  'best_eligible_reference':best['reference_accession'] if best else '',
                  'best_reciprocal_similarity_percent':val,
                  'best_reference_current_order':best['reference_order'] if best else '',
                  'best_reference_current_family':best['reference_family'] if best else '',
                  'best_reference_current_genus':best['reference_genus'] if best else '',
                  'best_reference_current_species':best['reference_species'] if best else '',
                  'best_family_relation':best['family_relation'] if best else 'no_eligible_reference_candidate',
                  'best_genus_exact_label_agreement':q['genus']==best['reference_genus'] if best and genus_named else '',
                  'best_similarity_bin':similarity_bin(val),'best_same_lineage_similarity_percent':same_best,
                  'eligible_references_similarity_gt95':sum(r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']>95 for r in ep),
                  'same_lineage_references_similarity_gt95':sum(r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']>95 for r in same),
                  'same_lineage_references_similarity_ge70':sum(r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']>=70 for r in same),
                  'different_lineage_references_similarity_ge70':sum(r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']>=70 and r['family_relation'] in ['different_current_family_label','historical_family_current_order_discordant'] for r in ep),
                  'different_lineage_references_similarity_gt95':sum(r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']>95 and r['family_relation'] in ['different_current_family_label','historical_family_current_order_discordant'] for r in ep),
                  'same_genus_references_similarity_ge70':sum(r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']>=70 and r['reference_genus']==q['genus'] for r in ep) if genus_named else '',
                  'same_genus_references_similarity_gt95':sum(r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']>95 and r['reference_genus']==q['genus'] for r in ep) if genus_named else '',
                  'herelleviridae_ge60_same_lineage':any(r['reciprocal_similarity_percent']>=60 for r in same) if q['family']=='Herelleviridae' else '',
                  'scope':'reference similarity corroboration; rank-specific phylogenetic criteria remain separate'}
        query_summary.append(qsummary)
    assert len(query_summary)==len({r['query_id'] for r in query_summary})==manifest['query_count']
    common.write_tsv('reference-similarity-pairs.tsv',all_pairs)
    common.write_tsv('query-corroboration.tsv',query_summary)
    family=[]
    for label in sorted({r['catalog_family'] for r in query_summary}):
        subset=[r for r in query_summary if r['catalog_family']==label]
        family.append({'catalog_family':label,'eligible_queries':len(subset),
                       'queries_with_complete_reference_candidates':sum(r['eligible_complete_exemplars']>0 for r in subset),
                       'queries_gt95_to_any_complete_reference':sum(r['eligible_references_similarity_gt95']>0 for r in subset),
                       'queries_gt95_same_lineage':sum(r['same_lineage_references_similarity_gt95']>0 for r in subset),
                       'queries_ge70_same_lineage':sum(r['same_lineage_references_similarity_ge70']>0 for r in subset),
                       'queries_best_reference_family_discordant':sum(r['best_family_relation'] in ['different_current_family_label','historical_family_current_order_discordant'] for r in subset),
                       'queries_best_reference_family_discordant_ge70':sum(r['best_family_relation'] in ['different_current_family_label','historical_family_current_order_discordant'] and r['best_reciprocal_similarity_percent']>=70 for r in subset),
                       'queries_best_reference_family_discordant_gt95':sum(r['best_family_relation'] in ['different_current_family_label','historical_family_current_order_discordant'] and r['best_reciprocal_similarity_percent']>95 for r in subset),
                       'queries_no_complete_reference_candidates':sum(r['eligible_complete_exemplars']==0 for r in subset)})
    common.write_tsv('family-corroboration-summary.tsv',family)
    summary={'query_count':len(query_summary),'reference_fasta_records':manifest['reference_records'],
             'current_complete_bacterial_Caudoviricetes_exemplars_in_fasta':len(eligible),
             'pair_count':len(all_pairs),'query_best_similarity_bins':dict(Counter(r['best_similarity_bin'] for r in query_summary)),
             'best_reference_family_relations':dict(Counter(r['best_family_relation'] for r in query_summary)),
             'best_reference_family_relations_ge70':dict(Counter(r['best_family_relation'] for r in query_summary if r['best_reciprocal_similarity_percent'] is not None and r['best_reciprocal_similarity_percent']>=70)),
             'best_reference_family_relations_gt95':dict(Counter(r['best_family_relation'] for r in query_summary if r['best_reciprocal_similarity_percent'] is not None and r['best_reciprocal_similarity_percent']>95)),
             'queries_with_gt95_similarity_to_eligible_reference':sum(r['eligible_references_similarity_gt95']>0 for r in query_summary),
             'queries_with_gt95_similarity_to_same_lineage':sum(r['same_lineage_references_similarity_gt95']>0 for r in query_summary),
             'queries_with_ge70_similarity_to_same_lineage':sum(r['same_lineage_references_similarity_ge70']>0 for r in query_summary),
             'queries_with_ge70_similarity_to_different_lineage':sum(r['different_lineage_references_similarity_ge70']>0 for r in query_summary),
             'queries_with_gt95_similarity_to_different_lineage':sum(r['different_lineage_references_similarity_gt95']>0 for r in query_summary),
             'queries_with_named_catalog_genus':sum(r['same_genus_references_similarity_ge70']!='' for r in query_summary),
             'queries_with_ge70_similarity_to_same_named_genus':sum(r['same_genus_references_similarity_ge70']!='' and r['same_genus_references_similarity_ge70']>0 for r in query_summary),
             'Herelleviridae_queries_ge60_same_lineage':sum(r['herelleviridae_ge60_same_lineage'] is True for r in query_summary),
             'families':family,'query_quality_counts':dict(Counter(r['quality'] for r in query_summary)),
             'individual_query_elapsed_seconds_sum':total_elapsed,
             'scope':'554近完整命名Caudoviricetes的固定参考双向相似度佐证；>95、70–95等为数值区间，非统一正式taxon分配规则；family支持由参考lineage继承，不代替family-level phylogeny。',
             'negative_scope':'Mash k21/s5000, distance<=0.2, top10命中genus扩展候选；阴性不表明新属、新种或全面参考排除。',
             'validation':{'unique_queries':True,'all_similarity_values_0_100':True,'identity_fraction_le_aligned_fraction':True},
             'runtime':{s:json.loads((ROOT/f'{s}-timing.json').read_text()) for s in ['pilot-direct','remaining-direct']},

                         'blastn':'2.16.0+','mash':'2.3'},
             'code_sha256':{p.name:common.sha(p) for p in [SOURCE/'taxonomy_compare.py',SOURCE/'taxonomy_direct.py',Path(__file__),SOURCE/'taxonomy.sbatch',SOURCE/'validate_metric.py']}}
    common.save('corroboration-summary.json',summary)

{numerator} 条与相同 lineage 参考的 similarity >95%，{counterpart} 条达到 ≥70%。Autographiviridae 的相符关系按当前 Autographivirales order 核对，其余按当前 family 名称核对。数值区间呈现参考序列关系，正式 species、genus 和 family 分配仍依各 rank 的适用标准。[逐条证据](query-corroboration.tsv) · [全部双向配对](reference-similarity-pairs.tsv) · [family 分层](family-corroboration-summary.tsv) · [汇总 JSON](corroboration-summary.json)
```
